about_zh: 编辑器、终端、构建、测试——日常写代码的那一圈。

repos.description: A collective list of free APIs
repos.summary_zh: public-apis 是一个由社区维护的免费 API 集合库，涵盖地理定位、金融、天气、通信等多个领域，提供即用型 RESTful API 接口，支持 Postman 一键调用，助力开发者快速集成第三方数据服务。
repos.summary_en: The public-apis repository is a community-curated collection of free, ready-to-use REST APIs across diverse domains like geolocation, finance, weather, and communication, enabling developers to quickly integrate third-party data services via Postman.

repos.description: An opinionated list of awesome Python frameworks, libraries, software and resources.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Python 是一个精选的 Python 框架、库、软件和资源的权威列表，涵盖 Web 开发、数据科学、机器学习、自动化工具等多个领域，为开发者提供高质量的开源工具参考。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Python is an opinionated curated list of top-tier Python frameworks, libraries, software, and resources across domains like web development, data science, machine learning, and automation, serving as a definitive reference for developers.

repos.description: 🙃   A delightful community-driven (with 2,400+ contributors) framework for managing your zsh configuration. Includes 300+ optional plugins (rails, git, macOS, hub, docker, homebrew, node, php, python, etc), 140+ themes to spice up your morning, and an auto-update tool that makes it easy to keep up with the latest updates from the community.
repos.summary_zh: Oh My Zsh 是一个社区驱动的 zsh 配置管理框架，提供 300+ 插件（如 Git、Docker、Node.js）和 140+ 主题，支持自动更新。它通过丰富的扩展功能提升终端体验，让用户在开发效率与个性化之间获得平衡，同时保持轻量与易用性。
repos.summary_en: Oh My Zsh is a community-driven framework for managing zsh configurations, offering 300+ optional plugins (e.g., Git, Docker, Node.js) and 140+ themes, with auto-update support. It enhances terminal productivity and personalization through extensible plugins and beautiful themes, balancing power and simplicity for developers.

repos.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: HelloGitHub 是一个专注于分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的月刊，每月28日定期发布，涵盖有趣项目、开源书籍、实战及企业级项目。旨在通过精选优质开源内容，帮助用户快速发现开源魅力，激发学习兴趣，降低入门门槛，从而爱上开源生态。
repos.summary_en: HelloGitHub is a monthly publication that curates and shares interesting, beginner-friendly open-source projects from GitHub. Released on the 28th of each month, it features engaging projects, open-source books, practical tutorials, and enterprise-level codebases to help newcomers discover the joy of open source and build real-world skills quickly.

repos.description: :cn: GitHub中文排行榜，各语言分设「软件 | 资料」榜单，精准定位中文好项目。各取所需，高效学习。
repos.summary_zh: GitHub中文排行榜是一个按编程语言分类的中文开源项目榜单，涵盖软件与资料两类，提供总榜、增速榜和新秀榜，帮助开发者高效发现优质中文开源项目，降低语言障碍，提升学习效率。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Chinese Top Charts is a categorized ranking system of high-quality Chinese open-source projects by programming language, featuring software and knowledge categories, with overall, growth, and new repo rankings to help developers discover and learn from top Chinese projects efficiently.

repos.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 是一款开源 AI 智能体，将 Gemini 的强大功能直接集成到终端中，提供对 Gemini 3 模型的轻量级访问，支持 Google 搜索、文件操作、Shell 命令等内置工具，并具备 MCP 扩展能力，专为命令行开发者设计，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
repos.summary_en: Gemini CLI is an open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal, offering lightweight access to Gemini 3 models with built-in tools like Google Search, file operations, and shell commands, plus extensibility via MCP (Model Context Protocol), designed for developers who live in the command line.

repos.description: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing and Automation. It allows testing Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API.
repos.summary_zh: Playwright 是一个现代化的 Web 测试与自动化框架，支持 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 三大浏览器内核的统一 API 调用。其核心优势在于内置智能等待机制、原生支持跨浏览器测试、无人工超时设计，以及自动生成测试追踪与录屏功能，显著提升端到端测试的稳定性与效率。
repos.summary_en: Playwright is a modern framework for web testing and automation that provides a single API to test Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browsers. It features built-in auto-waiting, cross-browser support, no artificial timeouts, and native tracing/video capture, making end-to-end tests more reliable and efficient.

repos.description: Model Context Protocol Servers
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的官方参考服务器实现，涵盖文件操作、网络抓取、Git 管理、内存存储等场景，支持多语言 SDK（Python、TypeScript 等），旨在帮助开发者理解 MCP 架构并构建安全的 LLM 工具集成方案。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers reference implementations of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including file system access, web fetching, Git operations, and memory management. Built with multi-language SDKs (Python, TypeScript, etc.), it serves as an educational resource for developers to build secure LLM-integrated tools using MCP.

repos.description: 🌐 Make websites accessible for AI agents. Automate tasks online with ease.
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的网页自动化框架，通过 LLM 驱动浏览器完成复杂在线任务。支持主流大模型（Gemini、Claude 等），提供 stealth 模式云浏览器服务，实现高效、隐蔽的网页交互与数据采集，适用于自动化测试、信息抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use is an AI agent framework that enables LLM-driven automation of web tasks. It supports major LLMs (Gemini, Claude, etc.) and offers stealth cloud browsers for secure, scalable automation. Ideal for web scraping, testing, and data collection with seamless integration.

repos.description: :zap: Dynamically generated stats for your github readmes
repos.summary_zh: GitHub Readme Stats 是一个动态生成 GitHub 统计信息的项目，可自动在个人 README 中展示仓库贡献、语言使用、活跃度等数据，支持高度自定义主题、布局与指标，提升开发者主页展示效果。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Readme Stats dynamically generates GitHub statistics for READMEs, displaying repository contributions, language usage, activity metrics, and more. It supports customizable themes, layouts, and options to enhance developer profile visibility.

repos.description: The Python programming language
repos.summary_zh: CPython 3.15.0 alpha 6 是 Python 官方参考实现的源代码仓库，提供完整的构建指南、跨平台编译支持及开发者工具链。项目包含完整的标准库、构建系统（configure/make）、测试套件和性能优化选项（如 PGO 和 LTO），适用于开发、调试及生产环境部署。
repos.summary_en: CPython 3.15.0 alpha 6 is the official reference implementation of the Python programming language, containing source code, build instructions, and developer tools. It supports cross-platform compilation, includes the full standard library, test suite, and performance optimizations like PGO and LTO for production-ready builds.

repos.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
repos.summary_zh: CLI-Anything 致力于将任意软件转化为原生 AI 智能体工具，通过统一接口桥接 AI 代理与真实世界软件。支持一键安装社区构建的 CLI 工具，提供 OpenClaw、Cursor 等平台兼容方案，覆盖 16+ 应用并实现 1839 项测试全通过。核心功能包括自动化注册、元技能发现及 JSON/人类可读双输出格式。
repos.summary_en: CLI-Anything enables any software to become agent-native, bridging AI agents with real-world tools via standardized interfaces. Features one-command installation from the community-driven CLI-Hub, compatibility with platforms like Cursor and Claude Code, support for 16+ applications, and 100% test pass rate (1,839 tests). Includes automated registry updates, meta-skill discovery, and dual JSON/human-readable output formats.

repos.description: A list of cool features of Git and GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是 GitHub 和 Git 的高级功能速查表，涵盖隐藏特性如忽略空白符、分支对比、行号高亮、任务列表、Emoji 支持、Gist 使用、Hub 工具等，帮助开发者提升工作效率，适用于日常开发协作与代码审查场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a comprehensive cheat sheet of advanced Git and GitHub features, including whitespace ignoring, branch comparisons, line highlighting, task lists, emoji support, Gists, Hub CLI, and more—designed to boost developer productivity in collaborative coding and code review workflows.

repos.description: aider is AI pair programming in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: Aider 是一款终端 AI 结对编程工具，支持与主流大模型（如 Claude、GPT-4、DeepSeek）协作开发，具备代码库映射、Git 集成、100+ 语言支持和 IDE 插件能力，实现自然语言驱动的代码修改与项目管理。
repos.summary_en: Aider is an AI pair programming tool in the terminal that collaborates with LLMs like Claude and GPT-4 to edit code, manage projects, and integrate with Git. It supports codebase mapping, IDE plugins, and works across 100+ programming languages via natural language commands.

repos.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.
repos.summary_zh: Cypress 是一款专为浏览器端应用设计的现代化端到端测试框架，提供快速、易用且可靠的测试体验。它支持实时重载、时间旅行调试和自动等待等特性，显著提升前端测试效率与稳定性，适用于现代 Web 应用的全流程自动化测试。
repos.summary_en: Cypress is a modern end-to-end testing framework designed for browser-based applications, offering fast, easy, and reliable testing. It features real-time reloads, time-travel debugging, and automatic waiting to enhance frontend test efficiency and stability, ideal for full-stack automation across modern web apps.

repos.description: A pure Unix shell script ACME client for SSL / TLS certificate automation
repos.summary_zh: acme.sh 是一个纯 Unix shell 脚本实现的 ACME 客户端，用于自动化 SSL/TLS 证书申请与续期。支持 ECDSA、通配符和多域名证书，兼容主流操作系统和容器环境，部署简单，仅需3分钟掌握，是运维自动化的理想工具。
repos.summary_en: acme.sh is a pure Unix shell script ACME client for automating SSL/TLS certificate issuance and renewal. It supports ECDSA, wildcard, and SAN certificates, runs on major OS platforms and containers, and is easy to deploy—masterable in just 3 minutes for efficient DevOps automation.

repos.description: The uncompromising Python code formatter
repos.summary_zh: Black 是一个无妥协的 Python 代码格式化工具，强制统一代码风格，提升团队协作效率。它基于 AST 分析实现确定性格式化，支持 Python 3.10+ 及 Jupyter Notebook，提供极小 diff 输出以加速代码审查，并内置语法有效性验证确保代码安全。
repos.summary_en: Black is the uncompromising Python code formatter that enforces consistent style across projects. It reformats entire files in place using AST analysis, supports Python 3.10+ and Jupyter Notebooks, produces minimal diffs for faster code reviews, and validates syntax safety through built-in AST checks.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提升 AI 提示词质量的优化工具，支持多轮迭代优化、双模式提示词处理、实时对比测试及多模型集成（OpenAI/Gemini/DeepSeek等），同时提供文生图、图生图、MCP协议支持等高级功能，适用于角色扮演、知识图谱提取、创意写作等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is an AI prompt optimization tool designed to enhance prompt quality through intelligent refinement, multi-round iteration, and dual-mode optimization. It supports real-time comparison, integration with major AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek), advanced features like text-to-image generation, MCP protocol compatibility, and secure client-side processing for reliable and efficient prompt engineering.

repos.description: Teams-first Multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: oh-my-claudecode 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的多智能体协同框架，采用零学习曲线理念。通过团队模式（team）实现 staged pipeline 自动化开发流程，支持 tmux CLI 工作器扩展 Codex/Gemini 能力，提供 deep-interview 需求澄清和 /ccg 混合协作技能，显著提升团队协作效率。
repos.summary_en: oh-my-claudecode is a zero-learning-curve multi-agent orchestration framework for Claude Code. It enables automated team-based development via staged pipelines, supports tmux CLI workers for Codex/Gemini integration, offers deep-interview for requirement clarification, and provides /ccg skill for mixed AI collaboration to boost team productivity.

repos.description: Fish-like autosuggestions for zsh
repos.summary_zh: zsh-autosuggestions 为 zsh 终端提供类 Fish 的实时命令建议功能，基于历史记录和补全引擎智能生成建议。支持自定义高亮样式与建议策略，可无缝集成 Oh My Zsh，显著提升命令行输入效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: zsh-autosuggestions delivers Fish-like real-time command suggestions for zsh, leveraging history and completion engines. Features customizable highlighting and multiple suggestion strategies, integrates seamlessly with Oh My Zsh to boost terminal productivity.

repos.description: The first real AI developer
repos.summary_zh: GPT Pilot 是一款革命性的 AI 开发者工具，旨在通过 LLM 自动生成生产级应用代码，开发者仅需监督与协作。它支持从需求到完整功能的全流程开发，具备调试、对话反馈和代码审查能力，是首个真正意义上的 AI 开发者伴侣。
repos.summary_en: GPT Pilot is an innovative AI developer tool that leverages LLMs to autonomously generate production-ready application code, with developers overseeing and collaborating throughout the process. It supports end-to-end development from requirements to full features, including debugging, interactive feedback, and code review, representing the first true AI developer companion.

repos.description: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform that provides DevOps and IT teams with on-demand and secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, Database and RemoteApp endpoints through a web browser.
repos.summary_zh: JumpServer 是一款开源的堡垒机（PAM）平台，为 DevOps 和 IT 团队提供通过浏览器安全访问 SSH、RDP、Kubernetes、数据库及远程应用端点的能力，支持权限管理、会话审计与自动化运维，具备完善的 RBAC 权限控制与多协议支持。
repos.summary_en: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform enabling secure, on-demand access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, and RemoteApp endpoints via a web browser, featuring comprehensive auditing, RBAC, and multi-protocol support for DevOps and IT teams.

repos.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Chrome DevTools MCP 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Gemini、Claude、Cursor 等）设计的 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议实现浏览器自动化、性能分析与深度调试。支持网络请求分析、截图、控制台日志追踪及性能追踪，结合 Puppeteer 实现可靠操作，适用于网页自动化与智能调试场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome DevTools MCP is an MCP server enabling AI coding agents (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Cursor) to control and inspect a live Chrome browser via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It provides advanced debugging, performance tracing, network analysis, and screenshot capabilities using Puppeteer for reliable automation, ideal for web automation and intelligent debugging.

repos.summary_zh: Void 是一款开源的 Cursor 替代 IDE，支持在代码库中使用 AI 智能体、可视化变更与检查点，并允许本地部署任意模型。其核心优势在于直接与 AI 服务商通信而不保留用户数据，基于 VSCode 深度定制，提供高度可定制的 AI 编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Void is an open-source alternative to Cursor, enabling AI agents to work on your codebase with checkpointing, change visualization, and local model hosting. It communicates directly with AI providers without storing your data, built as a VSCode fork with a focus on innovation over feature parity.

repos.description: YApi 是一个可本地部署的、打通前后端及QA的、可视化的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: YApi 是一款高效、易用、功能强大的可视化接口管理平台，支持本地部署，专为开发、产品、测试团队提供优雅的 API 管理服务。基于 Json5 和 Mockjs 定义接口结构，集成接口调试、自动化测试、Mock 期望等功能，支持 Postman/HAR/Swagger 导入，并提供丰富的插件生态与代码生成工具，助力企业级接口协作与效率提升。
repos.summary_en: YApi is a powerful, user-friendly, and efficient visual API management platform designed for developers, product managers, and QA teams. It enables seamless creation, publishing, and maintenance of APIs with features like Json5/Mockjs-based data modeling, automated testing, mock server with expectations, and support for importing from Postman, HAR, and Swagger. With a rich plugin ecosystem and code generation tools, it enhances API collaboration and productivity in enterprise environments.

repos.description: Patched fonts for Powerline users.
repos.summary_zh: Powerline 字体仓库提供专为 Powerline 状态栏插件优化的预配置字体，支持多种流行编程字体（如 Hack、Fira Mono、Meslo 等），涵盖 BSD、Apache、SIL 等开源许可证，适用于 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 终端环境，提升终端显示美观性与可读性。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides pre-patched fonts optimized for the Powerline statusline plugin, featuring popular programming fonts like Hack, Fira Mono, and Meslo under open licenses such as BSD, Apache, and SIL. It supports quick installation via script or package manager across Linux, macOS, and Windows terminals, enhancing visual appeal and readability.

repos.description: 🚀✨ Minimalistic, powerful and extremely customizable Zsh prompt
repos.summary_zh: Spaceship Prompt 是一款极简、强大且高度可定制的 Zsh 终端提示符，提供丰富的信息展示，包括 Git 状态、多语言运行时环境、包版本、电池电量、Kubernetes 上下文等，支持深度自定义配置，显著提升终端使用体验。
repos.summary_en: Spaceship Prompt is a minimalistic, powerful, and highly customizable Zsh prompt that displays essential information like Git status, runtime environments (Node.js, Python, etc.), package versions, battery level, and Kubernetes context, with extensive customization options for enhanced terminal productivity.

repos.description: 文言文編程語言 A programming language for the ancient Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: 文言（wenyan-lang）是一款基于文言文语法的编程语言，将古典中文与现代编程结合，支持自然语言编程风格。它可将文言文代码编译为 JavaScript，实现如 Hello World、埃拉托斯特尼筛法、快速排序等算法，兼具文化传承与实用功能，适合教学、趣味编程及跨时代语言实验。
repos.summary_en: Wenyan-lang is a programming language based on Classical Chinese grammar, blending ancient Chinese literature with modern programming. It compiles to JavaScript and supports natural language programming, enabling implementations of algorithms like Hello World, Sieve of Eratosthenes, and Quicksort, making it ideal for educational, cultural, and experimental use cases.

repos.description: Share your terminal as a web application
repos.summary_zh: GoTTY 是一个将命令行工具转换为 Web 应用的轻量级工具，支持通过浏览器远程访问终端会话。它提供端口监听、TLS 加密、基础认证、随机 URL 生成等安全特性，适用于运维、开发调试和远程协作场景。
repos.summary_en: GoTTY is a lightweight CLI tool that transforms command-line tools into web-based applications, enabling remote terminal access via browsers. It supports secure features like TLS encryption, basic authentication, random URL generation, and dynamic resizing for use in operations, debugging, and remote collaboration.

repos.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务实时监控工具，支持自然语言创建任务、多模态商品分析、定时调度与智能筛选。提供完整 Web 管理界面，集成 ntfy.sh/Bark/Telegram 通知，支持 Docker 一键部署与账号代理轮换，帮助用户高效发现目标商品。
repos.summary_en: AI-powered Xianyu monitoring system using Playwright for real-time/periodic multi-task tracking and analysis. Features natural language task creation, multimodal product analysis, cron scheduling, advanced filters (region/price/new-post), and full web UI with notifications via ntfy.sh/Bark/Telegram. Supports Docker deployment, account rotation, and proxy management.

repos.description: Notion-style WYSIWYG editor with AI-powered autocompletion.
repos.summary_zh: Novel 是一个开源的类 Notion WYSIWYG 编辑器，支持 AI 驱动的自动补全功能。基于 Next.js 和 Tiptap 构建，集成 OpenAI API 实现智能文本补全，提供类似 Notion 的流畅编辑体验，支持跨平台部署与扩展。
repos.summary_en: Novel is an open-source Notion-style WYSIWYG editor featuring AI-powered autocompletion. Built with Next.js and Tiptap, it integrates OpenAI APIs for intelligent text suggestions, offering a seamless editing experience akin to Notion, with cross-platform deployment and extensibility.

repos.description: ai副业赚钱大集合，教你如何利用ai做一些副业项目，赚取更多额外收益。The Ultimate Guide to Making Money with AI Side Hustles: Learn how to leverage AI for some cool side gigs and rake in some extra cash. Check out the English version for more insights.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为AI副业赚钱指南，系统整理利用AI技术开展副业的多种方法，涵盖内容创作、图片生成、音频处理、直播等方向。通过技术变现思路分享与实操案例，帮助用户在AI时代构建可持续的流量与收益模式，强调做垂类内容、卖工具（铲子）而非直接挖金子的策略。
repos.summary_en: This repository serves as a comprehensive guide to making money with AI side hustles, curating proven methods across content creation, image generation, audio processing, and live streaming. It emphasizes strategic positioning—focusing on niche content and selling tools (shovels) rather than competing in saturated markets—to help users build scalable AI-driven income streams in the current era.

repos.description: See interfaces like a human. E2E testing in natural language.
repos.summary_zh: Midscene.js 是一款基于 AI 视觉驱动的跨平台 UI 自动化工具，支持自然语言编写脚本控制网页、移动端及任意界面。通过集成 Puppeteer、Playwright 或 ADB/WebDriverAgent，实现智能表单填写、操作执行与数据提取，适用于测试、爬虫及办公自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Midscene.js is an AI-powered, vision-driven UI automation tool that enables natural language scripting to control web, mobile, and any interface. It integrates with Puppeteer, Playwright, or ADB/WebDriverAgent for intelligent form filling, interaction, and data extraction across platforms.

repos.description: Python version of the Playwright testing and automation library.
repos.summary_zh: Playwright-Python 是微软开源的跨平台浏览器自动化库，支持 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 三大内核。提供同步/异步 API，具备无头模式、自动等待、网络拦截等特性，适用于端到端测试、网页爬虫和自动化任务，性能可靠且支持多平台部署。
repos.summary_en: Playwright-Python is Microsoft's cross-browser automation library supporting Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. It offers sync/async APIs with features like headless mode, auto-waiting, and network interception, ideal for E2E testing, web scraping, and automation across platforms with high reliability and performance.

repos.description: A search tool helps dev to solve the naming things problem.
repos.summary_zh: CODELF 是一个智能变量命名工具，通过搜索 GitHub 等代码托管平台上的真实项目，为开发者提供精准的变量命名建议。支持 VS Code、Atom、Sublime Text 等编辑器插件，并集成每日算法题推荐功能，同时可管理 GitHub 仓库标签与收藏，显著提升代码命名效率与规范性。
repos.summary_en: CODELF is a smart variable naming tool that helps developers find real-world naming patterns by searching across GitHub and other code repositories. It offers IDE plugins for VS Code, Atom, and Sublime Text, features a daily algorithm practice guide, and includes GitHub repository tagging/organization tools to improve code naming consistency and productivity.

repos.description: A faster, simpler way to drive browsers supporting the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
repos.summary_zh: chromedp 是一个高效的 Go 语言库，用于通过 Chrome DevTools 协议驱动浏览器，无需外部依赖。它支持无头模式运行、页面截图、自动化操作等场景，适用于网页爬虫、自动化测试和数据采集。核心优势包括高性能、简洁 API 和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: chromedp is a high-performance Go library for driving browsers via the Chrome DevTools Protocol without external dependencies. It supports headless browsing, page screenshots, and automation tasks like web scraping and testing. Key features include fast execution, simple API, and cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: Python based web automation tool. Powerful and elegant.
repos.summary_zh: DrissionPage 是一款基于 Python 的网页自动化工具，结合浏览器控制与高效网络请求能力。它采用自研内核，无需 WebDriver，支持多标签页、跨 iframe 操作及智能等待机制，语法简洁优雅，内置大量人性化功能，适用于爬虫、测试与自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: DrissionPage is a Python-based web automation tool that integrates browser control and efficient HTTP requests. Built on a proprietary core, it eliminates the need for WebDriver, supports multi-tab operations, cross-frame element access, and intelligent waiting mechanisms. With elegant syntax and rich built-in features, it excels in web scraping, testing, and automation tasks.

repos.description: 超级速查表 - 编程语言、框架和开发工具的速查表，单个文件包含一切你需要知道的东西 :zap:
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是专为开发者设计的中文速查表集合，涵盖编程语言（如 Bash、Python、Go、JavaScript）、开发工具（如 Git、Gdb、Tmux）和文本编辑器（如 Vim、Emacs）的核心语法与命令，每个速查表均为单个文件，便于快速查阅，解决日常开发中频繁查阅文档的问题。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a curated collection of Chinese cheatsheets for developers, covering programming languages (Bash, Python, Go, JavaScript), development tools (Git, Gdb, Tmux), and text editors (Vim, Emacs). Each cheatsheet is a single-file reference for quick lookup, eliminating the need to search scattered documentation.

repos.description: MCP for xiaohongshu.com
repos.summary_zh: 小红书 MCP 是一个专为 xiaohongshu.com 设计的自动化工具，支持登录验证、图文/视频内容发布、内容搜索、推荐列表获取、帖子详情抓取、评论互动及用户主页信息提取。采用本地路径优先的图片处理机制，确保上传稳定性，并提供完整的 HTTP API 与 MCP 工具调用支持，适用于内容运营与数据采集场景。
repos.summary_en: Xiaohongshu MCP is an automation tool designed for xiaohongshu.com, supporting login verification, publishing text/image and video content, searching posts, fetching recommended feeds, retrieving post details with interactions, commenting, and user profile data extraction. It prioritizes local file paths for media uploads to ensure stability, and offers full HTTP API and MCP tool integration for content operations and data collection.

repos.description: Generic automation framework for acceptance testing and RPA
repos.summary_zh: Robot Framework 是一个开源的通用自动化框架，专用于验收测试、验收测试驱动开发（ATDD）和机器人流程自动化（RPA）。它采用简洁的纯文本语法，易于扩展，支持跨平台运行，并通过丰富的生态系统和 Python 集成提供强大的测试能力。
repos.summary_en: Robot Framework is an open-source generic automation framework for acceptance testing, acceptance test-driven development (ATDD), and robotic process automation (RPA). It features simple plain-text syntax, easy extensibility via Python-based libraries, and cross-platform support, backed by a rich ecosystem of tools and resources.

repos.description: Grumpy is a Python to Go source code transcompiler and runtime.
repos.summary_zh: Grumpy 是一个将 Python 源码编译为 Go 源码并生成原生代码的转编译器，旨在作为 CPython 2.7 的近乎即插即用的替代品。其核心优势在于无虚拟机（VM），直接生成高效 Go 代码，通过 Grumpy 运行时库提供类似 Python C API 的功能，适用于高性能 Python 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: Grumpy is a Python-to-Go transcompiler and runtime designed as a near drop-in replacement for CPython 2.7. It compiles Python source to Go code, which is then compiled to native machine code—eliminating the need for a VM. This enables high-performance execution via a Go-based runtime library, offering a viable alternative for deploying Python applications with native speed.

repos.description: :zap: Transfer files over wifi from your computer to your mobile device by scanning a QR code without leaving the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: qrcp 是一款通过扫描二维码实现电脑与移动设备间 Wi-Fi 文件传输的工具，无需离开终端即可完成操作。它通过生成包含随机路径 URL 的二维码，扫描后自动在移动端浏览器打开下载链接，支持单文件、多文件或文件夹传输，并提供压缩选项，兼容主流操作系统。
repos.summary_en: qrcp is a tool that enables Wi-Fi file transfer between computers and mobile devices by scanning a QR code, all from the terminal. It generates a QR code containing a URL with a random path; scanning it opens the download link in the mobile browser, supporting single/multiple files, folders, and optional compression. Compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows.

repos.description: auto sign cursor
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一个自动化 Cursor Pro 在线签到的工具，支持无人值守运行，适用于提升账户活跃度。采用 Python 实现，具备跨平台兼容性，并集成文档说明与社区支持，适合开发者学习自动化脚本与网页交互技术。
repos.summary_en: This project automates Cursor Pro online check-ins using Python, enabling unattended operation to boost account activity. It features cross-platform compatibility, comprehensive documentation, and community support, ideal for learning web automation and scripting techniques.

repos.description: Fuzzy String Matching in Python
repos.summary_zh: FuzzyWuzzy 是一个用于 Python 的模糊字符串匹配库，现已迁移至 TheFuzz。它提供高效的字符串相似度计算功能，适用于数据清洗、文本匹配等场景，支持多种匹配算法和加权评分。
repos.summary_en: FuzzyWuzzy is a Python library for fuzzy string matching, now migrated to TheFuzz. It enables efficient string similarity computation using various algorithms and weighted scoring, ideal for data cleaning and text matching tasks.

repos.description: A simple, open source bilingual translation extension & Greasemonkey script (一个简约、开源的 双语对照翻译扩展 & 油猴脚本)
repos.summary_zh: KISS Translator 是一款简约开源的双语对照翻译工具，支持浏览器扩展与油猴脚本两种形式。它适配主流浏览器，集成 Google、OpenAI、DeepL 等10+翻译服务，覆盖网页翻译、划词翻译、输入框翻译、YouTube字幕翻译等场景，支持自定义规则、术语词典、跨端数据同步及AI上下文记忆，提供高度灵活的翻译体验。
repos.summary_en: KISS Translator is a minimalist, open-source bilingual translation tool available as both a browser extension and a Tampermonkey script. It supports 10+ translation services including Google, OpenAI, and DeepL, covering web page translation, text selection, input field translation, and YouTube subtitle translation. Features include custom rules, term dictionaries, cross-device sync via KISS-Worker, and AI context memory for enhanced translation quality.

repos.description: A persistent service that generates mock data quickly and provids visualization view.
repos.summary_zh: Easy Mock 是一个快速生成模拟数据并提供可视化界面的持久化服务，支持团队协作、Swagger 导入、Mock.js 语法及自定义响应配置，适用于前后端分离开发中的接口模拟与测试。
repos.summary_en: Easy Mock is a persistent service that quickly generates mock data with a visualization interface, supporting team collaboration, Swagger import, Mock.js schema, and customizable responses for frontend-backend development and API testing.

repos.description: A configurable set of panels that display various debug information about the current request/response.
repos.summary_zh: Django Debug Toolbar 是一个可配置的调试面板集合，实时展示当前请求/响应的详细信息，包括 SQL 查询、模板渲染、缓存状态等，显著提升 Django 开发调试效率。支持社区贡献的第三方扩展面板，兼容 Django 4.2+，并提供异步视图实验性支持。
repos.summary_en: Django Debug Toolbar is a configurable set of panels that display detailed debug information about the current request/response, including SQL queries, templates, caching, and more. It enhances Django development by providing real-time insights and supports third-party community panels. Compatible with Django 4.2+, with experimental async view support.

repos.summary_zh: beautiful-mermaid 是一个高性能 Mermaid 图表渲染库，支持 SVG 和 ASCII 双输出模式，具备 15 种内置主题、零 DOM 依赖、同步渲染等特性，专为 AI 编程场景优化，可在终端和 UI 中无缝使用。
repos.summary_en: beautiful-mermaid is a high-performance Mermaid diagram renderer supporting dual SVG/ASCII output, 15 built-in themes, zero DOM dependencies, and synchronous rendering. Optimized for AI-assisted programming with seamless terminal and UI integration.

repos.description: Create *beautiful* command-line interfaces with Python
repos.summary_zh: docopt 是一个 Python 命令行接口生成工具，通过编写美观的文档字符串自动生成解析器，支持基于 Usage 模式的参数和选项解析，简化 CLI 开发流程，提升代码可读性。
repos.summary_en: docopt is a Python library that automatically generates command-line interfaces from docstrings, parsing usage patterns and options to create clean, readable CLI tools without manual parser coding.

repos.description: https://getsurfboard.com
repos.summary_zh: Surfboard 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的自动化工具平台，支持网页爬虫、数据抓取与任务自动化。它提供直观的界面和强大的调度能力，帮助用户快速构建和部署 AI 驱动的自动化工作流，适用于内容聚合、数据收集等场景。
repos.summary_en: Surfboard is an automation platform designed for AI agents, enabling web scraping, data extraction, and task automation. It offers an intuitive interface and robust scheduling to help users build and deploy AI-driven workflows efficiently, ideal for content aggregation and data collection.

repos.description: Git your game on!
repos.summary_zh: Githug 是一个通过游戏化方式学习 Git 命令的实践工具，包含多个难度递增的关卡，每个关卡要求玩家使用特定 Git 命令达成目标。它基于 Ruby 开发，支持跨平台运行，提供提示、重置和关卡列表功能，适合 Git 初学者系统掌握版本控制技能。
repos.summary_en: Githug is a practical game designed to teach Git through interactive levels. Each level challenges users to use specific Git commands to achieve a goal. Built in Ruby, it runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows, offering hints, resets, and level progression to help beginners master version control effectively.

repos.description: Embrace the APIs of the future. Hug aims to make developing APIs as simple as possible, but no simpler.
repos.summary_zh: Hug 是一个极简且高性能的 Python API 框架，基于 Falcon 构建，大幅简化 API 开发流程。支持自动文档生成、参数类型转换、路由装饰器等功能，强调自文档化、快速开发和测试友好，适用于现代 Python 后端服务开发。
repos.summary_en: Hug is a minimalist, high-performance Python API framework built on Falcon that simplifies API development. It features automatic documentation, type conversion, decorators for routing, and emphasizes self-documenting code, fast development, and easy testing for modern Python backend services.

repos.description: Learn javascript in one picture.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目通过一张思维导图（Mind Map）直观展示 JavaScript 核心语法与概念，涵盖函数、对象、作用域、闭包等关键知识点，适合快速查阅与教学。采用可视化设计，单图呈现语言全貌，支持多语言版本，并计划扩展 Python3 和 Go 版本。
repos.summary_en: This project visualizes JavaScript syntax and concepts in a single mind map, covering functions, objects, scope, closures, and more. Designed for quick reference and teaching, it offers a comprehensive yet concise overview. Multi-language support and upcoming Python3/Go versions enhance its utility.

repos.description: curl statistics made simple
repos.summary_zh: httpstat 是一个简洁高效的命令行工具，用于可视化 curl 请求的详细统计信息，包括 DNS 解析、TCP 连接、TLS 握手、HTTP 请求和响应等关键阶段耗时。它用 Python 编写，单文件无依赖，支持丰富的环境变量配置，适用于网络调试和性能分析。
repos.summary_en: httpstat is a simple yet powerful command-line tool that visualizes detailed curl request statistics, including DNS lookup, TCP handshake, TLS negotiation, and HTTP request/response timings. Written in single-file Python with zero dependencies, it offers rich customization via environment variables for network debugging and performance analysis.

repos.description: 中国软件著作权申请材料 生成器 Skills，本 Skills 通过阅读本地项目，自动生成全套 .docx 软著申请材料，全开源，无须再付费购买任何软著申请服务
repos.summary_zh: 本开源项目提供全自动软件著作权申请材料生成工具，通过分析本地真实项目代码，自动生成符合官方要求的.docx格式全套申请资料（含申请表、操作手册、代码材料），支持前30页/后30页规则处理，全程本地运行保障数据安全，避免付费代办服务，显著降低软著申请门槛。
repos.summary_en: This open-source project provides an automated tool to generate complete software copyright application materials. By analyzing local real project code, it automatically creates compliant .docx packages (including application forms, operation manuals, and source code) following official requirements, supports 30-page rules for code extraction, runs entirely locally for data security, eliminating paid proxy services.

repos.description: VSCode插件：自动生成，自动更新VSCode文件头部注释, 自动生成函数注释并支持提取函数参数，支持所有主流语言，文档齐全，使用简单，配置灵活方便，持续维护多年。
repos.summary_zh: koroFileHeader 是一款 VSCode 插件，专注于自动生成文件头部注释、自动更新编辑信息，并支持函数注释与参数提取。支持所有主流编程语言，配置灵活，文档详尽，自2018年持续维护，拥有超39.7万用户，日均安装量达200-500次，助力开发者规范代码风格与提升编码效率。
repos.summary_en: koroFileHeader is a VSCode plugin that automates file header comment generation, updates last editor and timestamp, and supports function documentation with automatic parameter extraction. It works across all major programming languages, offers flexible configuration, comprehensive documentation, and has been actively maintained since 2018 with over 397K users and daily installs of 200–500.

repos.description: Python package for doing RPA
repos.summary_zh: RPA for Python 是一个强大的自动化工具包，提供简洁的 API 实现网页、桌面应用及 OCR 流程的自动化，支持跨平台运行，适用于重复性任务的高效处理，显著提升工作效率。
repos.summary_en: RPA for Python is a powerful automation toolkit offering a simple API to automate web, desktop, and OCR workflows across platforms, enabling efficient handling of repetitive tasks with minimal code.

repos.description: Chrome扩展：支持GPT（Codex） / kiro / Grok自动注册、上传
repos.summary_zh: FlowPilot 是一款 Chrome 扩展，专为批量自动化 ChatGPT OAuth 注册与登录流程设计。支持多邮箱服务（如 QQ、163、DuckDuckGo、Cloudflare 等）获取验证码，具备自动填写表单、密码生成、失败重试、自定义邮箱池及号池管理等功能，适用于 CPA/SUB2API 账号批量运营场景。
repos.summary_en: FlowPilot is a Chrome extension designed for batch automation of ChatGPT OAuth registration and login. It supports multiple email services (e.g., QQ, 163, DuckDuckGo, Cloudflare) to retrieve verification codes, with features like auto-form filling, password generation, retry on failure, custom email pools, and account management—ideal for scaling CPA/SUB2API operations.

repos.description: iFlow cli is a comprehensive command-line intelligence that embeds in your terminal, analyzes your repositories, does coding tasks, interprets your needs across contexts, and boosts efficiency by performing tasks from simple file operations to complex workflow automation.
repos.summary_zh: iFlow CLI 是一款终端内嵌的 AI 智能助手，支持自然语言交互、代码仓库分析、多模态输入及复杂工作流自动化。集成 iFlow 开放市场，一键安装 MCP 工具与子代理，提供免费版多模态模型（如 Kimi K2、Qwen3 Coder）支持，具备计划模式、任务压缩、插件扩展等高级功能，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: iFlow CLI is an AI-powered terminal assistant that analyzes codebases, executes coding tasks, and automates workflows via natural language. It integrates free multimodal models (e.g., Kimi K2, Qwen3 Coder), supports SubAgents and MCP tools from its Open Market, and offers advanced features like plan mode, context compression, and plugin support for enhanced developer productivity.

repos.description: 🚀 KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API【特长：长文本解读整理】，支持高速流式输出、智能体对话、联网搜索、探索版、K1思考模型、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索、智能体对话、长文档解读及图像解析，零配置部署，兼容ChatGPT接口，支持多路token轮询与自动会话清理，仅供测试用途。
repos.summary_en: KIMI AI long-text LLM reverse API supporting high-speed streaming, multi-turn dialogue, web search, agent conversations, document interpretation, and image parsing. Zero-config deployment, ChatGPT-compatible interface, multi-token support, and automatic session cleanup. For testing only.

repos.description: cursor IDE enjoy VIP
repos.summary_zh: cursor-vip 是一个通过共享方式解锁 Cursor IDE 付费 VIP 功能的工具，支持多语言配置与代理模式。它提供稳定的 Claude 模型访问，通过脚本或二进制文件快速部署，适用于开发者绕过区域限制使用高级 AI 编程功能，但稳定性不及官方版本。
repos.summary_en: cursor-vip is a tool that unlocks Cursor IDE's paid VIP features via shared access, supporting multi-language configuration and proxy modes. It offers stable Claude model access, easy deployment via scripts or binaries, and enables developers to use advanced AI coding features despite regional payment restrictions, though with lower stability than the official version.

repos.description: A light and plugable JavaScript library for integrated 2D/3D maps.
repos.summary_zh: maptalks-gl 是一个基于 WebGL 和 WebGPU 驱动的全新地图引擎，专为高性能 2D/3D 地图可视化而设计。支持矢量切片、3DTiles 和 GLTF 格式，提供丰富的 3D 分析功能与交通模拟动画，兼容旧版 maptalks API，便于迁移。
repos.summary_en: maptalks-gl is a WebGL and WebGPU-driven map engine for high-performance 2D/3D mapping. It supports vector tiles, 3DTiles, and GLTF formats, offering advanced 3D analysis and traffic simulation. With backward-compatible APIs, it enables seamless migration from legacy maptalks.

repos.description: A cross-platform and extendable version manager with support for Java, Node.js, Golang, Python, Flutter, .NET & more
repos.summary_zh: vfox 是一款跨平台、可扩展的版本管理器，支持 Java、Node.js、Go、Python、Flutter、.NET 等多种运行时环境。它通过插件系统统一管理多语言开发环境，支持项目级版本隔离、自动切换和主流 shell 集成，简化了多项目环境下的依赖配置复杂度。
repos.summary_en: vfox is a cross-platform, extensible version manager (similar to nvm, asdf-vm) supporting Java, Node.js, Go, Python, Flutter, .NET and more. It enables unified management of multiple runtime versions across projects via plugins, with automatic environment switching, project-level isolation, and seamless shell integration for simplified development workflows.

repos.description: Warcraft III Peon voice notifications (+ more!) for Claude Code, Codex, IDEs, and any AI agent. Stop babysitting your terminal. Employ a Peon today.
repos.summary_zh: peon-ping 是一款为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 等）提供 Warcraft III 等游戏角色语音通知的开源工具，支持多平台（macOS/Linux/Windows/WSL2）。通过语音和屏幕横幅提醒开发者任务完成或需要交互，避免终端监控中断工作流，同时支持自定义音效包和 MCP 集成。
repos.summary_en: peon-ping is an open-source tool that delivers Warcraft III and other game character voice notifications to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It alerts users via audio and on-screen banners when tasks complete or require attention, eliminating constant terminal monitoring. Supports cross-platform use, custom sound packs, and MCP integration.

repos.description: Visible multi-agent CLI workspace for mixing Codex, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, Cursor, Copilot, Pi, OpenCode, and other AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: CCB（Claude Codex Bridge）是一个多AI智能体协作平台，支持Claude、Codex和Gemini等模型的实时协同工作。通过项目级团队管理、命名代理通信和持久化上下文，实现零拷贝的任务委派与广播同步，适用于复杂开发流程的自动化协作场景。
repos.summary_en: CCB (Claude Codex Bridge) is a real-time multi-AI collaboration platform enabling seamless coordination between Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It features persistent context, minimal token overhead, named agent communication, and project-level team management for efficient AI-driven development workflows.

repos.description: Chrome扩展：支持OpenAI OAuth注册(自动开通plus账号)、验证码获取、CPA/sub/cpdex2api回调验证与自动恢复
repos.summary_zh: 该Chrome扩展专为批量自动化ChatGPT OAuth注册与登录流程设计，支持CPA面板授权获取、邮箱自动生成（DuckDuckGo/Cloudflare/Gmail/2925）、多类型验证码接收（QQ/163/Hotmail/Inbucket）及回调验证。具备单步执行、自动运行、日志追踪和配置保存功能，适用于大规模账号管理场景。
repos.summary_en: This Chrome extension automates bulk ChatGPT OAuth registration/login via CPA panel integration, supporting dynamic email generation (DuckDuckGo/Cloudflare/Gmail/2925), multi-source verification code retrieval (QQ/163/Hotmail/Inbucket), and callback validation. Features step-by-step control, auto-execution, logging, and config persistence for scalable account management.

repos.description: ⭐This is a lightweight kit for generating astrolabes for Zi Wei Dou Shu (The Purple Star Astrology), an ancient Chinese astrology. It allows you to obtain your horoscope and personality analysis. 支持多语言轻量级获取紫微斗数排盘信息的javascript开源库。
repos.summary_zh: iztro 是一个轻量级紫微斗数排盘 JavaScript 库，支持多语言输入输出，可生成星盘数据、生肖星座、四柱运限及四化分析，提供链式调用和插件扩展，适用于个人命理分析、文化应用开发及学术研究。
repos.summary_en: iztro is a lightweight JavaScript library for generating Zi Wei Dou Shu astrolabes, supporting multi-language input/output, star charts, zodiac signs, four pillars, luck cycles, and four transformations. It offers chainable APIs, plugin extensibility, and is ideal for astrology apps, cultural tools, and research.

repos.description: 签到
repos.summary_zh: qiandao 是一个基于 HAR 编辑器的自动化签到框架，支持多平台自动签到任务管理。核心功能包括通过 HAR 文件录制与编辑浏览器操作，结合 Python 脚本实现定时自动签到，支持邮件通知与数据库存储。提供 Web 管理界面与 Docker 部署方案，适用于各类周期性签到场景，如论坛、学习平台等。
repos.summary_en: Qiandao is an automated check-in framework based on HAR editor, enabling scheduled check-ins across multiple platforms. It records and edits browser actions via HAR files, executes tasks using Python scripts, and supports email notifications and database storage. Features include a web admin interface and Docker deployment, ideal for recurring check-in scenarios such as forums and learning platforms.

repos.summary_zh: 该项目曾用于将微信读书的划线和笔记自动同步至Notion，通过GitHub Action定时执行实现数据迁移。现已因接口限制失效，官方推荐使用Chrome插件替代。项目提供微信群、QQ群支持及捐赠渠道，作者持续维护多个类似自动化工具。
repos.summary_en: This project previously automated syncing WeChat Read highlights and notes to Notion via GitHub Actions. It is now deprecated due to API limitations, with a Chrome extension recommended as the current solution. The author maintains related automation tools and offers community support through WeChat/QQ groups.

repos.description: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension that allows you to specify, plan, and implement software features.
repos.summary_zh: Conductor 是 Gemini CLI 的扩展工具，通过上下文驱动开发（Context-Driven Development）实现软件功能的规范化生命周期管理。它支持在编码前制定详细规格与执行计划，确保代码质量与团队一致性，适用于新项目和现有项目的智能开发流程管控。
repos.summary_en: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension enabling Context-Driven Development by managing the full lifecycle of software features—from context setup, spec/plan generation, to safe implementation. It ensures high-quality, team-aligned development with intelligent planning and git-aware reverts.

repos.description: Chrome extension to let agents control your browser. Runs Playwright snippets in a stateful sandbox. Available as CLI or MCP
repos.summary_zh: Playwriter 是一款 Chrome 扩展工具，允许 AI 智能体通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议控制用户浏览器。它直接连接已登录的 Chrome 实例，保留用户会话状态（如 cookies、扩展），避免新建浏览器带来的安全风险和检测问题。核心功能包括 Playwright API 调用、多会话隔离、网络请求拦截、页面调试编辑等，适用于自动化测试、数据采集和智能体交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwriter is a Chrome extension enabling AI agents to control your browser via CLI or MCP. It connects directly to your running Chrome instance, preserving logins, extensions, and cookies—avoiding the security risks and detection issues of spawning new browsers. Key features include full Playwright API access, isolated sessions, network interception, page debugging, and live code editing for automation, testing, and agent-driven workflows.

repos.description: 做最好的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: DOClever 是一款专为中小型团队打造的商业化开源接口管理平台，完全免费并支持内网部署。它提供接口全生命周期管理、可视化调试、Mock 服务、自动化测试、团队协作及多格式导入导出等功能，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议及多种参数类型，具备版本控制与快照能力，助力高效开发协作。
repos.summary_en: DOClever is a commercial open-source API management platform, fully free and supportable for on-premise deployment. It offers comprehensive API lifecycle management, visual debugging, Mock services, automated testing, team collaboration, and import/export in multiple formats. Supporting HTTP/HTTPS protocols and various parameter types, it features version control, snapshots, and seamless integration with Postman, Swagger, and RAP.

repos.description: AutoJs6-based ant forest energy auto-collect script (基于 AutoJs6 的蚂蚁森林能量自动收取脚本)
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Auto.js 6 的蚂蚁森林能量自动收取脚本，支持自动收集好友能量、能量雨识别与点击、排行榜策略配置等功能，提供模块化扩展与配置工具，适用于 Android 设备自动化操作，显著提升蚂蚁森林能量获取效率。
repos.summary_en: An Auto.js 6-based script for automating energy collection in Ant Forest, featuring auto-collection of friend energy, rain energy detection, ranking strategies, and modular configuration tools to enhance efficiency on Android devices.

repos.description: LinuxDo Scripts 扩展，功能持续更新，欢迎提出新想法！已上架 Chrome Web Store 和 Firefox 商店！文档地址：https://linuxdo-scripts.zishu.me
repos.summary_zh: LinuxDo Scripts 是一款专为 LinuxDo 论坛设计的浏览器扩展，集成界面优化、AI 辅助发帖、收藏夹增强等实用功能。支持 Chrome、Firefox 等主流浏览器，提供流畅的论坛交互体验，持续更新并兼容 idcflare.com 网站。
repos.summary_en: LinuxDo Scripts is a browser extension designed to enhance the LinuxDo forum experience, featuring interface optimization, AI-assisted posting, and enhanced favorites. Compatible with Chrome, Firefox, and other browsers, it offers seamless interaction and ongoing updates.

repos.description: 🚀 A statistical analysis tool for performance testing
repos.summary_zh: Hiper 是一款专为性能测试设计的统计分析工具，支持通过 Chrome 浏览器自动化采集页面加载时间、DNS 查询、TCP 连接等关键性能指标，提供详细的统计报告与可视化分析，适用于 Web 性能监控与优化。
repos.summary_en: Hiper is a statistical analysis tool for performance testing that automates Chrome browser interactions to collect key metrics like DNS lookup, TCP connection, and page load times, delivering detailed reports and visualizations for web performance monitoring and optimization.

repos.description: splinter - python test framework for web applications
repos.summary_zh: Splinter 是一个简洁易用的 Python Web 应用自动化测试框架，提供直观的 API 支持浏览器交互自动化。它基于 Selenium 构建，支持多浏览器驱动，具备快速开发、灵活扩展和真实场景适配能力，适用于 Web 测试、爬虫及自动化任务。
repos.summary_en: Splinter is a simple and consistent Python framework for automating web applications. Built on Selenium, it offers an intuitive API for browser automation, supporting multiple drivers and real-world use cases. Ideal for testing, scraping, and UI automation with robust and flexible capabilities.

repos.description: Real-time multi-AI collaboration: Claude, Codex & Gemini with persistent context, minimal token overhead
repos.summary_zh: CCB v6 是一款原生多智能体终端运行时，支持 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等 AI 模型的并行协作。通过持久化上下文和最小化 token 开销，实现可见的并发执行、原生通信及项目级作用域管理，适用于复杂开发场景下的多角色协同编程。
repos.summary_en: CCB v6 is a native multi-agent runtime for terminal split panes, enabling real-time collaboration across Claude, Codex, Gemini, and other AI models. It provides persistent context, minimal token overhead, visible concurrency, and project-scoped runtime with built-in agent communication and delegation.

repos.description: Modern photo gallery for photographers, with S3/GitHub sync, EXIF details, maps, and a WebGL viewer.
repos.summary_zh: Afilmory 是一款专为摄影师打造的高性能现代照片画廊平台，支持 S3/GitHub 同步、EXIF 元数据展示、地理地图可视化和 WebGL 渲染，提供响应式瀑布流布局和国际化支持，适用于自建或 SaaS 部署。
repos.summary_en: Afilmory is a modern, high-performance photo gallery platform for photographers, featuring S3/GitHub sync, EXIF metadata, interactive maps, and WebGL rendering. Built with React + TypeScript, it offers responsive masonry layouts, multi-storage support, and HDR/Live Photo compatibility for professional photo curation.

repos.description: Magic auto brightness based on screen contents 💡
repos.summary_zh: Lumen 是一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，能根据屏幕内容自动调节亮度。用户只需使用亮度键即可控制，系统会自动学习偏好。当屏幕显示深色内容（如终端）时自动调亮，显示浅色内容（如网页）时自动调暗，显著提升夜间使用舒适度，尤其适合长时间编程或阅读。
repos.summary_en: Lumen is a macOS menu bar app that automatically adjusts screen brightness based on displayed content. It learns user preferences via brightness keys, brightening the screen for dark content (e.g., terminal) and dimming it for light content (e.g., web pages), offering a more comfortable viewing experience, especially at night.

repos.description: 1407 张 AI 女装参考图集与虚拟试穿网站，支持中英检索、OpenAI Images / Gemini / 豆包及自定义 Base URL、API Key、模型。https://github.com/paipiange/nvzhuang

repos.description: A React markdown editor and previewer.
repos.summary_zh: MarkPlus 是一个功能强大的 React Markdown 编辑器与预览组件，支持实时编辑、多主题切换、可定制工具栏及数学公式、流程图等高级功能。它提供编辑器、预览或双栏模式，适用于内容创作与文档开发场景。
repos.summary_en: MarkPlus is a powerful React-based Markdown editor and previewer with real-time editing, customizable toolbar, multi-theme support, and advanced features like math formulas and flowcharts. It supports editor, preview, or dual-pane modes, ideal for content creation and documentation.

repos.description: Outlookmail Plus: Designed Specifically for Registration  |  Outlookmail Plus：专为注册而生  |
repos.summary_zh: OutlookMail Plus 是一款专为注册流程设计的邮箱管理器，聚焦验证码提取、临时邮箱管理和自动化注册场景。支持多邮箱类型（IMAP/OAuth/GPTMail）、批量导入分组、正则提取验证码链接，并提供受控API接口供自动化系统调用，同时集成Telegram通知与邮件推送能力。
repos.summary_en: OutlookMail Plus is a specialized email manager designed for registration workflows, focusing on verification code extraction, disposable email management, and automated account creation. It supports IMAP/OAuth/GPTMail accounts, batch import/grouping, regex-based code parsing, and offers controlled API endpoints for automation integration with Telegram/email notifications.

repos.description: MobaXterm Key Generate
repos.summary_zh: MobaXterm Keygen & Customizer 是一个现代化的 Web 工具，用于生成 MobaXterm 激活密钥并自定义终端设置。支持多版本兼容（v20.X/v25.4/v26.0）、主题切换、用户数配置、自定义 Logo、书签管理及插件集成，提供一键下载与文件合并功能，极大简化了 MobaXterm 的授权与个性化部署流程。
repos.summary_en: MobaXterm Keygen & Customizer is a modern web tool for generating activation keys and customizing the MobaXterm terminal emulator. It supports multiple editions, user count configuration, dark/light themes, custom logos, bookmarks, and plugin integration, enabling one-click downloads and merged license-customization deployment for streamlined setup.

repos.description: 😁 git commit message emoji 使用指南
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供了一套中文化的 Git Commit Emoji 使用指南，涵盖 30+ 个常用 emoji 及其对应代码，用于规范提交信息格式，提升代码历史可读性与团队协作效率。支持命令行显示 emoji，适用于多平台开发场景。
repos.summary_en: This repo provides a comprehensive guide for using Git commit emojis in Chinese, including 30+ emoji codes and their meanings to standardize commit messages, enhance code history clarity, and improve team collaboration. It supports emoji display in terminals and is suitable for cross-platform development.

repos.description: A wrapper that exposes Google AI Studio Build as OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic compatible APIs.（一个将 Google AI Studio Build 封装为兼容 OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic 风格 API 的工具）
repos.summary_zh: AIStudioToAPI 是一个将 Google AI Studio 封装为兼容 OpenAI、Gemini 和 Anthropic API 格式的工具，通过浏览器自动化技术实现网页端功能代理。支持多账号管理、工具调用（Function Calling）、生图与 TTS 模型访问，并提供可视化 Web 控制台和 VNC 登录，适用于需要统一接口调用 Google AI 能力的场景。
repos.summary_en: AIStudioToAPI is a wrapper that exposes Google AI Studio as compatible APIs for OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic formats. It uses browser automation to proxy web interface interactions, supporting multi-account management, tool calls, image/TTS models, and offering a visual web console with VNC login for unified access to Google's AI capabilities.

repos.description: 🐒一些修改自网络的油猴脚本 Some Tampermonkey scripts modified from the internet
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供一系列基于油猴脚本（Tampermonkey）的自动化工具，多数脚本改编自网络资源，涵盖网页功能增强、界面优化及实用小工具。所有脚本均托管于GreasyFork平台，支持多语言版本，具备高安装量和良好用户评价，适用于提升日常浏览与操作效率。
repos.summary_en: This repository hosts a collection of Tampermonkey user scripts, mostly modified from online sources, designed to enhance web functionality, optimize interfaces, and provide utility tools. Hosted on GreasyFork with multi-language support, these scripts boast high installation counts and positive user ratings, ideal for improving browsing efficiency and user experience.

repos.description: Multi-service toolkit for Tavily and Firecrawl signup automation, key validation, and isolated proxy pools.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个多服务注册与API密钥管理工具，专注于自动化注册并验证Tavily、Firecrawl和Exa的API密钥。通过真实浏览器模拟注册流程、集成Turnstile验证码破解、自动收取邮箱验证码，并对获取的密钥进行实际调用验证，确保可用性。支持跨平台运行，可选将密钥上传至统一代理池，专为MySearch-Proxy等聚合搜索网关提供稳定可靠的密钥上游来源。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a multi-service toolkit for automating registration and validation of API keys from Tavily, Firecrawl, and Exa. It simulates real browser signups, integrates Turnstile solver, auto-collects email verification codes, and validates keys via live API calls to ensure functionality. Cross-platform compatible, with optional upload to a unified proxy pool, serving as a reliable upstream key provider for aggregation search gateways like MySearch-Proxy.

repos.description: TVBox自用接口
repos.summary_zh: TVBox自用接口集合，提供多地域GitHub RAW加速服务与EPG电子节目指南源，支持直播源搜索及短链生成工具，适用于个人电视盒子流媒体播放场景，强调隐私与自用属性。
repos.summary_en: A personal-use TVBox interface repository offering multi-region GitHub RAW acceleration, EPG sources for electronic program guides, live stream search tools, and URL shortening services, designed for private streaming on media boxes without public promotion.

repos.description: Hacknical, hacker & technical. A website for GitHub user to make a better resume.
repos.summary_zh: Hacknical 是一个专为 GitHub 用户打造的在线简历生成平台，通过深度分析用户的 GitHub 贡献、代码仓库、技术栈等数据，自动生成可视化分析报告，帮助用户打造专业、数据驱动的编程简历。支持中英文切换、组织账号分析、移动端展示及 PDF 导出，技术栈涵盖 React、Koa2、MongoDB 等。
repos.summary_en: Hacknical is a web platform designed for GitHub users to generate data-driven resumes by analyzing their GitHub contributions, repositories, and tech stacks. It provides visual analytics and exportable reports, supporting English, organizations, mobile viewing, and PDF export with a tech stack including React, Koa2, and MongoDB.

repos.description: :books: 一起写Python文章，一起看Python文章 - 利用readthedocs的Python技术文章的收集和翻译。
repos.summary_zh: PyZh 是一个基于 ReadTheDocs 的 Python 技术文章翻译与收集项目，致力于汇聚优质英文技术文档并提供中文翻译。项目采用 RST 格式编写，支持多语言协作，提供 RSS 订阅和在线浏览功能，鼓励社区共同参与内容创作与翻译。
repos.summary_en: PyZh is a Python technology article translation and collection project built on ReadTheDocs, aiming to aggregate high-quality English technical articles with Chinese translations. It uses RST format, supports collaborative writing, offers RSS subscription and online reading, and encourages community contributions.

repos.description: 📕 小红书创作者MCP工具包 - 支持与AI客户端集成的内容创作和发布工具
repos.summary_zh: 小红书创作者MCP工具包是一个专为AI客户端（如Claude Desktop）设计的自动化内容创作与发布工具，支持图文/视频笔记自动发布、定时数据采集及创作者数据分析，提供Cookie管理、远程浏览器连接和CSV本地存储功能，实现LLM驱动的小红书运营全流程自动化。
repos.summary_en: The Xiaohongshu Creator MCP Toolkit is an AI-integrated automation tool for content creation and publishing, supporting image/video note posting, scheduled data collection, and creator analytics. It features cookie management, remote browser connectivity, and CSV storage, enabling full LLM-driven Xiaohongshu operations via MCP protocol integration.

repos.description: ChatGPT Team 账号自动轮转管理 - Codex 额度监控、自动换号、邮箱注册、CPA/Sub2API 认证同步
repos.summary_zh: AutoTeam 是一款 ChatGPT Team 账号自动化管理工具，支持自动注册、Codex OAuth 认证、额度监控与智能轮转。通过 Playwright 实现浏览器自动化，集成 FastAPI 提供 HTTP 接口和 Vue 3 管理面板，可同步 CPA 认证文件并定时巡检，确保团队账号高效稳定运行。
repos.summary_en: AutoTeam is an automated management tool for ChatGPT Team accounts, featuring auto-registration, Codex OAuth authentication, quota monitoring, and intelligent rotation. Built with Playwright for browser automation, it provides a FastAPI backend and Vue 3 dashboard, syncing CPA auth files and enabling scheduled health checks to maintain optimal account performance.

repos.description: A feature-rich, efficient text editor - Web Site
repos.summary_zh: Yu Writer Site 是一个功能丰富、高效的文本编辑器网站，提供现代化的写作体验。支持 Markdown 编辑、实时预览、多主题切换和本地存储，适用于内容创作者和开发者。项目采用轻量级架构，注重性能与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: Yu Writer Site is a feature-rich, efficient text editor web application offering a modern writing experience. It supports Markdown editing, live preview, multi-theme switching, and local storage, ideal for content creators and developers. Built with a lightweight architecture focused on performance and user experience.

repos.summary_zh: 这是一个简洁的 GitHub 仓库，项目名称为 'bye'，带有告别表情符号，可能用于快速退出或关闭某个进程、服务或应用，适合作为轻量级工具或脚本使用。
repos.summary_en: This is a simple GitHub repository named 'bye' with a farewell emoji, likely intended as a lightweight utility or script for exiting or closing processes, services, or applications.

repos.description: gpt team管理和自动邀请
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 的 ChatGPT Team 账号管理系统，支持管理员批量导入 AT Token、生成兑换码、自动同步团队信息及成员管理，用户通过兑换码自助加入团队。集成代理配置、Webhook 库存预警和第三方 API 自动补货，提供 Docker 一键部署与完整的前后端分离架构。
repos.summary_en: A FastAPI-based ChatGPT Team account management system enabling admins to bulk-import AT Tokens, generate redeem codes, auto-sync team data, and manage members. Users redeem codes to join teams via email. Features include proxy support, webhook inventory alerts, third-party API integration for auto-replenishment, and Docker deployment.

repos.description: 清理Augment缓存和生成设备SessionId/解决 VSCode、Cursor、JetBrains 系列 IDE 中 Augment 插件无法登录的问题（Sign in failed. If you have a firewall, please add）/将所有 d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com 域名统一指向延迟最低的服务器IP
repos.summary_zh: Augment 插件清理工具 v3.4 是一款专为解决 VSCode、Cursor、JetBrains 系列 IDE 中 Augment 插件登录失败问题而设计的跨平台工具。核心功能包括彻底清理插件缓存数据、生成设备 SessionId，以及通过智能测速优化 API 域名解析（将 d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com 指向延迟最低服务器）。支持交互式菜单和命令行模式，提供代理配置、安全预览等高级功能，兼容 Windows/macOS/Linux。
repos.summary_en: Augment Plugin Cleaner v3.4 is a cross-platform utility designed to resolve login failures in Augment plugin for VSCode, Cursor, and JetBrains IDEs. It features comprehensive cache/data cleanup, SessionId generation, and intelligent API domain optimization by testing latency of d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com endpoints. Supports interactive menus, CLI arguments, proxy configurations (Clash/V2Ray/custom), dry-run previews, and works on Windows/macOS/Linux with admin privileges for hosts file modification.

repos.description: 一个"制造技能的技能"。这个工具自动化了将任意 GitHub 仓库转换为标准化技能的全过程，是扩展 AI Agent 能力的核心工具。
repos.summary_zh: GitHub Skill Forge 是一个自动化工具，可将任意 GitHub 仓库一键转换为 AI Agent（如 Trae）可直接调用的标准化技能包。通过云端扫描、智能 RAG 提取核心代码与文档，生成上下文文件，无需本地克隆或复杂配置，显著提升 AI 助手处理开源项目的效率。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Skill Forge is an automation tool that transforms any GitHub repository into a standardized skill package for AI agents (e.g., Trae) to directly understand and invoke. It performs cloud-based scanning, smart RAG extraction of core logic and docs, and generates context bundles without local cloning or complex setup, dramatically improving AI efficiency in handling open-source projects.
