repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: ridiculously fast object serialization
repos.summary_zh: serpy 是一个极致快速的 Python 对象序列化框架，专为高性能场景设计。它支持将复杂数据类型（如 Django 模型、自定义类）高效转换为原生类型（字典、列表等），并易于转为 JSON。相比 marshmallow 或 Django REST Framework，其性能优势可达一个数量级以上，同时保持简洁的类继承式架构和高度可定制性。
repos.summary_en: serpy is a ridiculously fast object serialization framework for Python, optimized for high performance. It efficiently converts complex data types (e.g., Django models, custom classes) into native Python types (dicts, lists), easily convertible to JSON. It outperforms alternatives like marshmallow or Django REST Framework by an order of magnitude, while offering a clean, extensible class-based design with minimal code duplication.

repos.description: Pure Front-End API Testing Tool
repos.summary_zh: API CHECK 是一款纯前端 API 测试工具，专为 OpenAI 代理接口（如 oneapi、newapi）的可用性检测设计。支持实时响应速度、模型一致性等详细数据展示，提供云端与本地双存储方案，并集成暗黑模式、多语言切换等功能。支持 Vercel、Docker 及 Cloudflare 一键部署，保障数据安全且无需后端依赖。
repos.summary_en: API CHECK is a pure front-end tool for testing API availability, especially OpenAI proxy services like oneapi and newapi. It provides detailed metrics such as response time and model consistency, with cloud and local storage options. Features include dark mode, multi-language support, and one-click deployment via Vercel, Docker, or Cloudflare, ensuring secure, client-side-only operation.

repos.description: A JavaScript library to display Photo Sphere panoramas.
repos.summary_zh: Photo Sphere Viewer 是一个基于 Three.js 的 JavaScript 库，用于在网页上展示 360×180 度全景图。支持 equirectangular 投影格式，兼容 Android 4.2+ 拍摄的照片球，提供丰富的交互控制与自定义选项，适用于虚拟旅游、房地产展示等场景。
repos.summary_en: Photo Sphere Viewer is a JavaScript library built on Three.js for displaying 360×180 degree panoramas on web pages. It supports equirectangular projection, integrates with Android Photo Sphere, and offers extensive customization and interaction features for immersive experiences.

repos.description: 专为tmailor调教，古法永动机版本！（支持duck/33mail/tmailor）
repos.summary_zh: Infinitoai 是一款基于 Chrome Side Panel 的自动化扩展，专为 OpenAI OAuth 注册/登录流程设计。支持 Duck、33mail、TMailor 多邮箱源及 QQ/163/Inbucket 等验证码收件通道，具备完整工作流编排、自动重试、失败统计与人工接管能力，适用于批量验证与自动化测试场景。
repos.summary_en: Infinitoai is a Chrome Side Panel extension automating OpenAI OAuth registration/login workflows. It supports multiple email sources (Duck, 33mail, TMailor) and verification channels (QQ/163/Inbucket), featuring full workflow orchestration, auto-retry, failure tracking, and manual intervention capabilities for batch validation and testing.

repos.description: Visual design tool for building Terminal User Interfaces
repos.summary_zh: TUIStudio 是一款类 Figma 的终端用户界面可视化设计工具，支持拖拽式组件编排、实时 ANSI 预览、多框架代码导出（Ink/BubbleTea/Textual 等），内置 20+ TUI 组件与丰富主题系统，提供绝对/弹性/网格布局引擎及完整撤销重做功能。
repos.summary_en: TUIStudio is a Figma-like visual editor for designing Terminal UIs, featuring drag-and-drop components, live ANSI preview, multi-framework export (Ink/BubbleTea/Textual), 20+ built-in TUI elements, layout engines (absolute/flex/grid), and real-time theme switching with gradient support.

repos.description: 把网页AI转api，如claude2api
repos.summary_zh: Web2API 是一个网页 AI 服务桥接工具，将 Claude Web 等前端 AI 能力封装为 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API。支持图片输入、流式输出、工具调用及可视化配置，无需修改客户端即可对接现有 SDK（如 Cursor）。提供 Docker 和源码部署方式，集成浏览器指纹与代理管理，适用于自动化对话场景。
repos.summary_en: Web2API is a bridge service that wraps web-based AI services (primarily Claude Web) into standard OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It supports image input, streaming/non-streaming output, tool calls, and offers a visual config UI for proxy groups, account pools, fingerprints, and time zones. Deployable via Docker or source code, it enables seamless integration with existing clients like OpenAI SDK or Cursor without code changes.

repos.description: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
repos.summary_zh: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档自动生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供配置选项控制文档可见性。项目包含演示环境，支持模板扩展，适用于需要快速搭建标准化 API 文档的中大型后端服务。
repos.summary_en: DRF Docs is an automated API documentation generator for Django Rest Framework, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It auto-generates interactive API docs by parsing DRF project structures, with configurable visibility and template extension support. Includes a demo project for development and testing, ideal for medium-to-large backend services requiring standardized API documentation.

repos.description: Python项目自动化多服务器部署的工具
repos.summary_zh: essay 是一个基于 Fabric 的 Python 项目自动化部署工具，支持多服务器打包与部署。它通过标准化流程简化开发到生产环境的交付，集成 PyPI 服务器和 Git 仓库，提供快速构建、版本化打包、虚拟环境管理及 Supervisord 进程控制，适用于需高效扩展的 Python 服务场景。
repos.summary_en: Essay is a Python project automation deployment tool based on Fabric, supporting multi-server packaging and deployment. It streamlines the development-to-production pipeline with standardized workflows, integrating PyPI servers and Git repositories. It enables rapid builds, versioned packaging, virtual environment management, and Supervisord process control, ideal for scalable Python service deployments.

repos.description: :zap: Sync all of your VSCode settings across multiple devices, supports any VSCode variant.
repos.summary_zh: VSCode Syncing 是一款强大的 VSCode 扩展，支持跨设备同步用户设置、键位绑定、扩展、语言包和代码片段至 GitHub Gist。支持增量同步、自动安装扩展、代理配置，并兼容 VSCodium、Cursor 等 VSCode 衍生版本。
repos.summary_en: VSCode Syncing is a powerful extension that synchronizes all VSCode settings—including user settings, keybindings, extensions, snippets, and locales—across multiple devices via GitHub Gist. It supports incremental sync, automatic extension management, proxy configuration, and works with any VSCode variant like VSCodium and Cursor.

repos.description: A CLI for BOSS 直聘 — search jobs, view recommendations, manage applications via reverse-engineered API
repos.summary_zh: boss-cli 是一个基于逆向工程 API 的 BOSS 直聘命令行工具，支持职位搜索、个性化推荐、申请管理、与招聘者聊天及发送问候等功能。具备多浏览器 Cookie 自动提取、丰富筛选条件、结构化输出和跨平台支持，适用于求职自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: boss-cli is a CLI tool for BOSS Zhipin that enables job searching, recommendations, application management, and recruiter chat via reverse-engineered APIs. It supports browser cookie extraction, advanced filtering, structured output, and cross-platform usage for automated job hunting.

repos.description: A Web-app for OpenManus
repos.summary_zh: OpenManusWeb 是一个基于 OpenManus 的 Web 应用，提供无需邀请码即可使用的 AI 智能体服务。该项目由 MetaGPT 团队开发，支持快速部署和自定义代理任务，具备完整的网页界面和演示视频，适用于自动化任务处理和智能决策场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenManusWeb is a web application built on OpenManus that enables access to AI agents without an invite code. Developed by the MetaGPT team, it offers customizable agent workflows with a user-friendly interface, supporting automation tasks and intelligent decision-making through a complete web-based platform.

repos.description: 更好的Autoteam，实现前端到后端全方位的加强，同时可以批量获取免费号
repos.summary_zh: AutoTeam-F 是基于 cnitlrt/AutoTeam 的增强版工具，核心改进在于实现免费 ChatGPT Personal 账号批量注册（Fix + Free），并优化操作体验。支持临时邮箱自动注册、Codex OAuth 双模式认证、智能轮转与额度管理、CPA 双向同步、Web 面板可视化操作及 Docker 部署，提供失败分类诊断与软停止等实用功能。
repos.summary_en: AutoTeam-F is an enhanced fork of cnitlrt/AutoTeam, focusing on batch generation of free ChatGPT Personal accounts (Fix + Free) and improved UX. It supports automated registration via temp email (cf_temp_email/maillab), Codex OAuth for Team/Personal modes, smart rotation with quota monitoring, CPA bidirectional sync, web dashboard, Docker deployment, failure diagnostics, and soft-stop capabilities.

repos.description: 基于 team-manage 增强的ChatGPT团队账号管理系统，集成了一键 Token 提取、CPA 凭证导出、Token 自动刷新与福利车位分发等实用功能。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 的 ChatGPT Team 车位管理系统，集成一键 Token 提取、CPA 凭证导出、Token 自动刷新与福利车位分发功能。支持团队账号批量导入、兑换码管理、库存预警、Webhook 联动及售后风控，专为稳定运营场景优化。
repos.summary_en: A FastAPI-based ChatGPT Team management system featuring one-click token extraction, CPA credential export, automatic token refresh, and benefit seat distribution. Supports bulk team import, voucher management, inventory alerts, webhook integration, and after-sales risk control for stable operations.

repos.description: 借用的都是大佬的本地接口和在线接口。
repos.summary_zh: TVBox 是一个基于开源接口的电视直播与点播平台，集成多个大佬提供的本地和在线数据接口，支持多源切换、高清播放及自定义配置，适用于家庭娱乐与媒体中心场景。
repos.summary_en: TVBox is an open-source IPTV and video-on-demand platform that aggregates local and online data interfaces from various contributors. It supports multi-source switching, high-definition playback, and customizable configurations for home entertainment and media center use.

repos.summary_zh: Auto.js 是一个基于无障碍服务的 Android 平台 JavaScript IDE，支持自动化操作、界面录制、控件选择器及脚本打包。本修改版修复了内存泄漏、优化调度机制、集成 PaddleOCR、ONNXRuntime 和 ncnn 推理引擎，增强模型本地推理能力，适用于蚂蚁森林等脚本场景，同时支持防检测变包名功能。
repos.summary_en: Auto.js is an Android-based JavaScript IDE leveraging accessibility services for automation, featuring UI recording, powerful selector APIs, and APK packaging. This modified version fixes memory leaks, integrates PaddleOCR, ONNXRuntime, and ncnn for local model inference, supports anti-detection via fake package names, and is optimized for stable script execution in apps like Ant Forest.

repos.description: 基于Outlook Email的Chrome扩展：支持OpenAI OAuth古法注册与账号标签管理
repos.summary_zh: 基于Chrome MV3扩展的OpenAI OAuth自动化注册工具，集成Outlook邮箱平台API实现邮箱可视化管理、验证码轮询回填及自动标签标记。支持自建多域名邮箱资源（如Gmail、QQ、163等），提供Side Panel交互界面与完整9步注册流程，确保账号唯一性与流程可追溯性。
repos.summary_en: A Chrome MV3 extension automating OpenAI OAuth registration via Outlook Email API, featuring visual mailbox management, captcha polling/reply, and auto-tagging. Supports multi-domain email resources (Gmail, QQ, 163, etc.) with Side Panel UI and full 9-step flow for reliable account tracking.

repos.description: 自用tvbox配置
repos.summary_zh: Meow 是一个自用 TVBox 配置项目，提供完整的配置文件 meow.json 及安卓客户端 Tvbox-xxx.apk。支持多站点源管理，部分站点标记为不支持搜索，需手动设置为源使用，适合个人影音资源自动化播放场景。
repos.summary_en: Meow is a personal-use TVBox configuration project offering a complete config file (meow.json) and Android client (Tvbox-xxx.apk). It supports multi-site source management, with some sites marked as non-searchable requiring manual source setup, ideal for automated media playback.

repos.description: 微信客户端模拟器，方便在本地进行微信公众平台API的开发和调试
repos.summary_zh: 微信客户端模拟器，基于tkinter开发，提供本地微信公众平台API调试环境。支持模拟关注/取消关注、自定义菜单点击等交互场景，通过XML数据模拟微信消息推送，简化开发测试流程。
repos.summary_en: WeChat client simulator built with tkinter for local debugging of WeChat Official Platform APIs. It simulates user interactions like following/unfollowing accounts and clicking custom menu items via XML data, enabling streamlined development and testing workflows.

repos.description: An efficient API documentation management tool that fully adheres to the OpenAPI specification and incorporates advanced LLM technology. This tool can automate the generation of API documentation, data models, and test cases, greatly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality.
repos.summary_zh: ApiCat 是一款高效 API 文档管理工具，完全遵循 OpenAPI 规范，集成先进 LLM 技术，可自动化生成 API 文档、数据模型和测试用例，显著提升开发效率与文档质量，支持本地部署与云端服务。
repos.summary_en: ApiCat is an efficient API documentation management tool fully compliant with the OpenAPI specification. It leverages advanced LLM technology to automate API documentation, data model, and test case generation, significantly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality. Supports local deployment and cloud services.

repos.description: Assistant for get HTTP ONLY Cookies.
repos.summary_zh: GetCookies 是一款 Chrome 扩展插件，专为突破 HTTP ONLY 限制而设计，可安全获取指定域下的 Cookie 数据。通过自定义 DOM 属性触发 Cookie 提取，支持跨域、指定名称与域名，并通过 postMessage 机制实现安全的跨页面通信，适用于自动化登录与数据抓取场景。
repos.summary_en: GetCookies is a Chrome extension that bypasses HTTP ONLY restrictions to securely extract cookies from specified domains. It triggers cookie retrieval via custom DOM attributes, supports cross-domain access, allows naming and domain filtering, and uses postMessage for safe cross-page communication, ideal for automation and login workflows.

repos.description: 净化Github搜索页，屏蔽cirosantilli等400+人的敏感仓库。
repos.summary_zh: GitHub搜索净化是一款浏览器脚本，通过屏蔽敏感用户（如CiroSantilli等400+人）的仓库，实现搜索结果页面的内容净化。支持完全隐藏或提示屏蔽、模糊/精确匹配模式，并提供五种检测机制（推荐MutationObserver），兼容Tampermonkey和Chromium内核浏览器，显著提升GitHub搜索体验。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Search Purification is a browser script that cleans search results by blocking repositories from sensitive users (e.g., CiroSantilli and 400+ others). It offers options to hide or flag blocked repos, supports fuzzy/exact matching, and uses five detection modes—recommending MutationObserver—for compatibility with Tampermonkey and Chromium-based browsers, enhancing search clarity.

repos.description: 2023年4、5月份心血来潮，想做TK，为了实现矩阵运营，开启此项目，但是最后由于各种原因，无法继续。现在将项目公开，希望能对后面做自媒体的有所帮助。本项目包括本地代理IP的配置，outlook邮箱申请（图片验证需要手动处理一下），邮箱验证码自动读取，tk账号注册和登录（这里也存在问题，单次可行，第二次会被识别次数太多，细节看readme），tk的模拟浏览视频，tk视频下载，视频搬运前的剪辑处理等等
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一套针对TikTok自媒体矩阵运营的自动化工具，涵盖Outlook邮箱注册与验证码自动抓取、TikTok账号注册登录、模拟浏览行为、无水印视频下载及智能剪辑处理。通过IP代理轮换、魔改Chrome浏览器、指纹伪装和反爬策略实现稳定运行，结合剪映API与FFmpeg实现视频去头尾、画中画、抽帧等高级编辑功能，为跨境内容创作者提供端到端解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This project is an end-to-end automation toolkit for TikTok content creators and matrix operators. It includes Outlook email registration with auto-verification code retrieval, TikTok account signup/login, simulated browsing behavior, watermark-free video downloads, and intelligent video editing via CapCut API and FFmpeg. Features include IP rotation, anti-detection browser fingerprinting, and advanced video processing such as trim, PIP, frame sampling, and signature obfuscation.

repos.summary_zh: Atlas 是专为 OpenClaw 生态设计的专业 AI 赏金猎人技能，支持自动发现 GitHub、Upwork 等平台的高回报任务，通过智能 ROI 矩阵评估收益与成本，并生成高质量代码提交。具备身份管理、止损保护及自动化交付能力，助力智能体高效完成付费任务。
repos.summary_en: Atlas is a professional AI bounty hunter skill for the OpenClaw ecosystem, autonomously discovering high-value tasks on GitHub, Upwork, and bug bounty platforms. It uses a smart ROI matrix to evaluate profitability, manages identity as a senior developer, and delivers high-quality pull requests with test evidence, featuring built-in stop-loss protection.

repos.description: Deepin Terminal written by vala
repos.summary_zh: Deepin Terminal 是深度操作系统默认终端模拟器，基于 Vala 语言开发，支持多标签页、分屏、快捷键操作及主题定制，提供高效命令行工作环境。
repos.summary_en: Deepin Terminal is the default terminal emulator for Deepin OS, built with Vala, offering multi-tab, split-screen, customizable shortcuts, and theming for efficient command-line workflows.

repos.description: 可同时输入多个初版提示词，开启多轮自动优化，连续得到高分后得到最终结果。
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer Studio 是一款自托管提示词优化工作台，支持多轮自动优化与人工干预。用户可输入初版 prompt，系统通过复核与生成机制持续迭代，最终输出可直接复用的完整提示词，适用于企业级 AI 应用开发与提示工程场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer Studio is a self-hosted prompt optimization studio that enables multi-round automated refinement with human-in-the-loop control. Users input initial prompts, and the system iteratively optimizes them through review and generation cycles, delivering a final, copy-paste-ready prompt for enterprise AI development and prompt engineering workflows.

repos.description: :metro: 即刻 Ⓙ SDK
repos.summary_zh: Jike Metro 🚇 是一个即刻（Jike）平台的 Python SDK，提供用户信息获取、动态浏览、内容发布、收藏管理、评论互动等全套接口，支持流式数据拉取与自动化操作，适用于开发者快速集成即刻生态功能。
repos.summary_en: Jike Metro 🚇 is a Python SDK for the Jike platform, offering comprehensive APIs for user profiles, news feeds, content creation, collections, comments, and interactions. It supports streaming data and automation, enabling developers to integrate Jike's ecosystem efficiently.

repos.description: A bash script to check if your VPS's IP is available for various OTT platforms
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本用于检测VPS IP在各主流OTT平台的可用性，支持自定义出口IP、代理、DNS及网络协议。基于curl实现，适用于Debian系统，提供灵活参数配置以适配不同网络环境。
repos.summary_en: This bash script checks VPS IP availability across major OTT platforms, supporting custom exit IPs, proxies, DNS settings, and network protocols via curl. Designed for Debian systems with flexible flags for diverse network configurations.

repos.description: 🎸 A portable guitar tabs editor 🎼 based on react.js, inspired by Markdown and LaTex.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 React.js 开发的便携式吉他谱编辑器，灵感来自 Markdown 和 LaTeX。采用 SVG 技术渲染和弦与谱表组件，支持实时预览。已发布两个相关 npm 包（react-guitar-lyrics、react-chord-generator）供开发者参考。具备响应式界面与基础编辑功能，适合音乐创作者快速编写吉他谱。
repos.summary_en: A portable guitar tabs editor built with React.js, inspired by Markdown and LaTeX. Uses SVG to render chords and tab notation with real-time preview. Includes two published npm packages (react-guitar-lyrics, react-chord-generator) for chord development. Designed for music creators to efficiently compose guitar tabs with a responsive interface.

repos.description: Community fetch recipes for bb-browser — pre-built adapters for Reddit, Twitter, GitHub, and more
repos.summary_zh: bb-sites 是 bb-browser 的社区站点适配器集合，提供 95+ 个预置脚本，将主流平台（如 Reddit、Twitter、GitHub、YouTube、Bilibili 等）转换为 CLI 命令。无需 API 密钥或反爬绕过，直接通过浏览器环境运行，支持搜索、内容抓取、用户交互等场景，实现网页内容的命令行化访问。
repos.summary_en: bb-sites is a community-driven collection of site adapters for bb-browser, enabling websites like Reddit, Twitter, GitHub, and YouTube to be accessed via CLI commands. With 95+ pre-built adapters across 35 platforms, it allows direct content retrieval without API keys or anti-bot workarounds, leveraging the browser's logged-in state for seamless automation.

repos.description: ⚠️ 封号风控升级，请勿大量使用 / High ban risk, personal testing only 🚨 Use at your own risk.
repos.summary_zh: Kiro Stack 是一个将 Amazon Kiro（原 Q Developer）账号转换为 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 的代理系统，结合 kiro-go 的管理面板与 kiro-gateway 的稳定转发能力，支持多账号池、自动 Token 刷新和双端点容错，适用于 Cursor、Claude Code 等 IDE 集成。
repos.summary_en: Kiro Stack is a proxy system that converts Amazon Kiro (formerly Q Developer) accounts into OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It combines kiro-go's web admin panel with kiro-gateway's stable request handling, featuring multi-account pools, auto-token refresh, and dual-endpoint fallback for use in IDEs like Cursor and Claude Code.

repos.description: PyTime is an easy-use Python module which aims to operate date/time/datetime by string.
repos.summary_zh: PyTime 是一个简洁易用的 Python 模块，专注于通过字符串操作日期、时间和 datetime 对象。它支持解析非标准格式的日期字符串（如 '2015.5.17'、'April 3rd 2015'），并允许通过自然语言式字符串进行时间加减运算（如 '2years 3mon'）。同时提供周、月时间区间计算及节日生成功能，适用于脚本自动化与数据处理场景。
repos.summary_en: PyTime is a user-friendly Python module designed to handle date/time/datetime operations via string input. It parses irregular date formats (e.g., '2015.5.17', 'NOV21th2015') and supports natural-language-like timedelta calculations (e.g., '2years 3mon'). Features include week/month interval generation, holiday computation, and datetime arithmetic, making it ideal for automation and data processing tasks.

repos.description: pac
repos.summary_zh: pac 是一个轻量级自动化工具，专注于简化日常任务流程。它通过简洁的脚本配置实现快速操作执行，适用于开发者和运维人员提升工作效率，支持跨平台运行和灵活扩展。
repos.summary_en: PAC is a lightweight automation tool designed to streamline routine tasks through simple script configurations. It enhances productivity for developers and ops teams by enabling quick execution of workflows, with cross-platform support and extensibility.

repos.description: Detect file modification in background and push it to git automatically.
repos.summary_zh: file_sync 是一个轻量级自动化工具，通过监听文件变化并自动提交到 Git 仓库，实现配置文件的实时同步与版本追踪。支持跨平台运行，可设置开机自启，适用于个人配置文件管理场景。
repos.summary_en: file_sync is a lightweight automation tool that monitors file modifications in the background and automatically pushes changes to a Git repository, enabling real-time synchronization and version tracking of configuration files. It supports cross-platform operation and can be configured to run at system startup.

repos.description: Self-hosted temporary email platform with SMTP receiving, verification code extraction, domain management, and API access.
repos.summary_zh: ShiroMail 是一个自托管的临时邮箱平台，支持实时 SMTP 邮件接收、验证码自动提取、域名管理、API 访问及管理员控制台。基于 Go + Gin + React + MySQL/Redis 构建，提供完整的邮箱生命周期管理、消息解析规则配置和自动化接口，适用于需要临时邮箱验证或测试的场景。
repos.summary_en: ShiroMail is a self-hosted temporary email platform featuring real-time SMTP ingestion, verification code extraction, domain management, API access, and an admin console. Built with Go, Gin, React, and MySQL/Redis, it offers full mailbox lifecycle control, message parsing rules, and automation APIs for testing or validation workflows.

repos.description: python code style guide book / python 代码、单元测试和项目规范
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是 Python 代码风格、单元测试与项目规范的完整指南，旨在为 Python 项目（尤其是 Web 项目）提供统一的开发标准。涵盖代码风格、测试实践、项目结构等核心内容，支持在线阅读与多种格式下载，采用 CC0 许可，鼓励社区协作完善。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a comprehensive Python code style guide, unit testing practices, and project standards, particularly for web projects. It covers coding conventions, testing methodologies, and project structure, available for online reading and download in multiple formats. Released under CC0, it encourages community contributions to improve and expand the guide.

repos.description: OpenAI中转
repos.summary_zh: 本项目将 Cursor 编辑器的 AI 能力转换为 OpenAI API 兼容接口，支持通过 Bearer Token 认证调用聊天补全功能。用户只需提供 WorkosCursorSessionToken 即可在其他应用中复用 Cursor 的 AI 服务，适用于集成开发、自动化脚本等场景。
repos.summary_en: This project converts Cursor editor's AI capabilities into an OpenAI-compatible API interface, enabling reuse of Cursor's AI functionality in other applications. It supports chat completion via Bearer Token authentication using WorkosCursorSessionToken, ideal for integration and automation use cases.

repos.description: 用 LLM 和 jina reader 生成的总结
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用 LLM 和 jina reader 自动读取 bookmark-collection 中的网页书签内容，生成结构化摘要。通过 GitHub Action 实现自动化处理，支持按月归档，适用于个人知识管理和内容聚合，核心亮点在于结合 AI 总结与网页内容提取技术。
repos.summary_en: This project uses LLM and jina reader to automatically extract and summarize web content from bookmarks in bookmark-collection. Integrated with GitHub Actions for automation, it supports monthly archiving and enables personal knowledge management through AI-powered content aggregation and summarization.

repos.description: tvbox自动整理
repos.summary_zh: tvbox自动整理是一个用于TVBox流媒体资源自动分类与管理的工具，支持多仓库和单仓库配置，提供JSON格式的资源索引文件，便于用户快速获取并整合影视、直播等视频内容。
repos.summary_en: Tvbox自动整理 is a tool for automated organization of TVBox streaming resources, supporting multi-repo and single-repo configurations with JSON-based index files to streamline access to video content like movies and live streams.

repos.description: singleFile + gh pages + deepseek api + notion db + tg bot = web clipper and notify
repos.summary_zh: Web Clipper Backend 是一个网页剪藏服务，支持将网页通过 SingleFile 插件保存至 GitHub Pages，利用 DeepSeek API 自动生成摘要与标签，并同步至 Notion 数据库，同时通过 Telegram Bot 推送通知，实现全自动化内容归档与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Web Clipper Backend is an automated web clipping service that saves web pages via SingleFile to GitHub Pages, uses DeepSeek API for AI-generated summaries and tags, syncs data to Notion database, and sends notifications via Telegram Bot, enabling seamless content archiving and knowledge management.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供经过筛选的高质量影视接口，包含单仓优选和多仓聚合方案，支持主流网盘下载TVBox及宝盒等第三方影视应用。所有接口内容均来自网络公开资源，仅供自用测试，强调版权合规与来源标注要求。
repos.summary_en: This project offers high-quality streaming interfaces, including single-source optimized and multi-source aggregated APIs, supporting downloads of TVBox and third-party apps via mainstream cloud storage. All content is sourced from public networks for personal use only, with strict copyright compliance and attribution requirements.

repos.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。
repos.summary_zh: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars 仓库，利用 AI 生成智能摘要与技术标签，支持并发处理、增量更新及多端同步（Obsidian/GitHub Pages），实现高效个人知识管理与技术检索。
repos.summary_en: Automatically fetches GitHub Stars repositories, generates AI-powered summaries and technical tags, supports concurrent processing, incremental updates, and syncs to Obsidian or GitHub Pages for efficient knowledge management.

repos.description: Cached instances for Django REST Framework
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为 Django REST Framework (DRF) 提供缓存实例功能，通过将序列化后的实例数据存储在缓存中，显著提升 API 读取性能。支持零数据库查询读取实例或仅一次查询获取主键列表，适用于高读负载场景。核心机制包括缓存代理类、JSON 序列化及缓存失效策略。
repos.summary_en: This project enhances Django REST Framework (DRF) by caching serialized instance data, enabling zero or minimal database queries for read-heavy APIs. It uses a cache-aware proxy to store only necessary attributes, including foreign keys and relations, improving performance for APIs with complex object relationships.

repos.description: python_sdk for TencentYoutuyun-person-face-service
repos.summary_zh: 腾讯云优图人脸服务Python SDK，提供人脸检测、比对、识别、验证及人脸库管理功能，支持本地图片与URL输入，集成API签名鉴权，适用于身份认证、安防监控等场景。
repos.summary_en: Tencent YouTu Face Service Python SDK enables face detection, comparison, recognition, and verification, with support for local images and URLs. It includes API authentication and person/group management, ideal for identity verification and security applications.

repos.description: 时光机打包 actions
repos.summary_zh: tvbox_builder 是一个用于打包时光机类 TVBox 配置的工具，通过集成卧龙和庞统等第三方项目，提供一键生成可部署的电视盒子应用包。支持版本管理与自动化构建，适用于流媒体聚合场景，具备高复用性和跨平台适配能力。
repos.summary_en: tvbox_builder is a tool for packaging TVBox configurations, integrating third-party projects like Wolong and Pangtong to generate deployable streaming app packages. It supports version management and automated builds, ideal for media aggregation with high reusability and cross-platform compatibility.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastMCP 框架的 VSCode 扩展，将 VSCode 转换为 MCP 服务器，支持通过 HTTP Streaming 和 SSE 协议远程执行内部命令，提供工作区信息查询、异步执行、命令白名单等能力，兼容 Model Context Protocol 标准。
repos.summary_en: A VSCode extension using FastMCP framework to convert VSCode into an MCP server, enabling remote execution of internal commands via HTTP Streaming and SSE, with workspace info, async execution, command whitelisting, and full Model Context Protocol compatibility.

repos.description: HF Space Manager 是一个用于管理 Hugging Face Spaces 的 Web 应用程序。它提供了直观的界面和API 接口，让你能够方便地查看和管理多个账号下的所有 Spaces。
repos.summary_zh: HF Space Manager 是一个专为 Hugging Face Spaces 设计的现代化监控管理平台，支持多账号 Spaces 实时状态监控、资源使用统计及远程操作（重启/重建）。采用赛博朋克风格界面，集成 Docker 部署与 RESTful API，提供权限分级控制，适用于个人或团队高效管理 AI 模型部署实例。
repos.summary_en: HF Space Manager is a modern web application for monitoring and managing Hugging Face Spaces instances. It offers real-time status tracking, resource usage metrics (CPU/memory), and remote operations (restart/rebuild) across multiple accounts. Features include a cyberpunk-themed UI, Docker deployment, role-based access control, and a secure REST API for external integrations.

repos.description: editor for guitar charts
repos.summary_zh: Charter 是一款免费的开源吉他谱编辑器，支持查看、播放和编辑吉他谱。基于 Java 开发，提供跨平台桌面应用体验（Windows、macOS、Linux），具备音频变速播放功能，适用于音乐教学与乐谱制作场景。
repos.summary_en: Charter is a free and open-source guitar chart editor with viewing, playback, and editing capabilities. Built in Java for cross-platform desktop use (Windows, macOS, Linux), it supports audio time-stretching via jasio and rubberband libraries, ideal for music education and sheet music creation.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Python + Playwright 的 Cerebras Cloud 批量自动化注册工具，集成临时邮箱服务实现全自动账号创建、邮件验证与 API Key 获取。支持 Web 管理界面与命令行双模式，具备反检测机制、并行流水线及 IP 切换提醒功能，适用于大规模云资源快速部署。
repos.summary_en: Automated bulk registration tool for Cerebras Cloud using Python and Playwright, integrating temporary email services to fully automate account creation, verification, and API key retrieval. Features dual-mode operation (Web UI/CLI), anti-detection measures, parallel processing, and IP rotation alerts for scalable cloud resource deployment.

repos.description: A controllable timing task widgets with Celery
repos.summary_zh: celery-task-tigger 是一个基于 Celery 的可控定时任务组件，支持任务执行次数限制（max_times）和自定义执行间隔（countdown），解决了原生周期性任务依赖 beat 的痛点，实现更灵活的任务调度与控制。
repos.summary_en: celery-task-tigger is a Celery-based controllable timing task widget that supports execution frequency control (max_times) and custom intervals (countdown), solving the limitation of native periodic tasks relying on beat for more flexible task scheduling.

repos.summary_zh: Arcee Bridge 是一个自动化工具，通过 YYDS Mail 自动创建邮箱并完成 Arcee AI 账号注册，获取 access_token 后将其封装为 OpenAI 兼容的 API 网关。支持完整注册流程（发邮件、验证、登录）并暴露 /v1/chat/completions 等标准接口，适用于快速接入 OpenAI 风格客户端或构建代理层实验环境。
repos.summary_en: Arcee Bridge is an automation tool that auto-registers Arcee accounts via YYDS Mail, retrieves access tokens, and exposes them as an OpenAI-compatible API gateway. It handles the full signup flow (email verification, login) and provides standard endpoints like /v1/chat/completions for easy integration with OpenAI-style clients or proxy layers.

repos.description: An out-of-the-box, lightweight JavaScript i18n auto-translation solution
repos.summary_zh: i18n-pro/core 是一个开箱即用的轻量级 JavaScript 国际化自动翻译解决方案，支持文本提取、多平台自动翻译（如 Google、OpenAI、百度等）、增量更新和日志追踪，提供文本即键、变量插值、类型标签等功能，简化多语言开发流程。
repos.summary_en: i18n-pro/core is an out-of-the-box, lightweight JavaScript i18n auto-translation solution that supports text extraction, multi-platform translation (e.g., Google, OpenAI, Baidu), incremental updates, and logging. It offers features like text-as-key, variable interpolation, and type tags to streamline internationalization.

repos.description: 一个基于Web技术构建，所见即所得的在线简谱编辑器
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于Web的在线简谱编辑器，提供所见即所得的编辑体验，支持全键盘输入音符、一键转调及高清图片导出功能，适用于音乐创作与教学场景，暂不支持移动端和五线谱。
repos.summary_en: A web-based numerical notation editor offering WYSIWYG editing, full keyboard note input, one-click transposition, and high-resolution image export for sheet music creation and education.

repos.description: 会议记录
repos.summary_zh: Meeting Mind 是一款智能会议记录与分析系统，集成实时语音识别（FunASR）、说话人分离和本地 LLM 分析能力。支持涉密模式本地处理、异步重转写、移动端适配及深色/浅色主题切换，确保数据隐私与高效协作。
repos.summary_en: Meeting Mind is an intelligent meeting transcription and analysis system combining real-time ASR (FunASR), speaker diarization, and local LLM-powered insights. It supports offline processing for sensitive data, async re-transcription, mobile responsiveness, and dark/light themes for secure and efficient meetings.

repos.description: Json 工具箱，主要功能Json 格式化、DIFF及AI工具等。https://json.ssooai.com
repos.summary_zh: JSON Tools Next 是一个现代化的 JSON 数据处理平台，提供多视图编辑器（文本/树形/差异对比/表格）、AI智能修复、JWT解析、数据格式互转等核心功能。基于 React+TypeScript+Vite 构建，支持深色主题与多标签页操作，集成 OpenAI API 实现智能 JSON 纠错与类型转换。
repos.summary_en: JSON Tools Next is a modern JSON data processing platform featuring multi-view editors (text/tree/diff/table), AI-powered repair, JWT parsing, and format conversion. Built with React+TypeScript+Vite, it supports dark mode, multiple tabs, and integrates OpenAI API for intelligent JSON correction and type mapping.

repos.description: 微信支付的python接口
repos.summary_zh: weixin_pay 是一个为 Python 开发者提供的微信支付接口库，简化了微信支付 API 的调用流程。该库经过实际项目测试验证，支持核心支付功能，适合快速集成到电商、服务类应用中，提升支付模块开发效率。
repos.summary_en: weixin_pay is a Python library providing a simplified interface for WeChat Pay API. Developed for production use, it supports core payment functionalities and has been tested successfully. Ideal for integrating WeChat Pay into e-commerce or service applications efficiently.

repos.description: Yet Another Pair Programming Package for Atom.
repos.summary_zh: Coeditor 是一个为 Atom 编辑器设计的实时协同编程插件，支持多用户无冲突文本编辑、语法高亮同步、文件操作同步及项目级协作感知。通过自建 WebSocket 服务器实现客户端间状态同步，适用于远程结对编程场景，需统一配置换行符以避免内容不一致。
repos.summary_en: Coeditor is a real-time collaborative programming plugin for Atom, enabling conflict-free text editing, syntax highlighting sync, file operations, and project awareness across multiple users. It relies on a custom WebSocket server for state synchronization, ideal for remote pair programming, with strict line ending consistency requirements across clients.

repos.description: 🚀 8000+ Verified n8n Workflows. Free to download. Includes a self-hostable frontend to browse and search automation templates.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是经过验证的8000+个n8n自动化工作流的开源集合，提供可直接下载使用的JSON格式模板。包含基于Next.js 14构建的自主托管前端，支持按角色和集成智能搜索，涵盖营销、DevOps、销售和AI等场景。数据以JSON和SQL形式开放，支持本地部署，致力于让自动化技术普惠大众。
repos.summary_en: This project offers 8,000+ verified n8n automation workflows in JSON format, freely downloadable for immediate use. It includes a self-hostable Next.js 14 frontend with intelligent search by role/integration, covering marketing, DevOps, sales, and AI scenarios. Open-source data (JSON/SQL) enables local deployment, promoting accessible automation technology for all.

repos.description: VPS上的AI聚合脚本
repos.summary_zh: VPSAI 是一个开源的 AI 服务快速部署工具，专为 VPS 环境设计。它通过一键脚本自动化部署多种流行 AI 服务（如 OneAPI、Open-WebUI 等），支持 Docker/Nginx 环境配置、HTTPS 自动证书申请及数据持久化备份。具备服务监控与更新功能，适用于快速搭建私有化 AI 服务集群。
repos.summary_en: VPSAI is an open-source tool for rapid deployment of AI services on VPS. It automates the setup of popular AI platforms (e.g., OneAPI, Open-WebUI) via one-click scripts, supporting Docker/Nginx configuration, HTTPS with Let's Encrypt, data persistence, and backup. Features service monitoring and updates, ideal for private AI infrastructure deployment.

repos.description: ActionAI 是基于大语言模型的命令行交互框架，支持多种模型切换、MCP协议，提供流畅的交互式聊天体验。通过终端界面，可以与AI进行自然对话，并通过强大丰富MCP服务端，让AI具备文件读写、网络访问、代码执行等能力。
repos.summary_zh: ActionAI是基于大语言模型的命令行交互框架，支持多模型切换与MCP协议集成，赋予AI文件读写、网络访问、代码执行等系统操作能力。通过终端实现自然对话与自动化任务处理，显著提升工作效率，适用于文档分析、数据报告生成、系统管理等复杂场景。
repos.summary_en: ActionAI is a command-line interface framework based on large language models, supporting multi-model switching and MCP protocol integration. It empowers AI with system-level capabilities like file operations, network access, and code execution via terminal interaction. Designed for automation of complex workflows such as document analysis, report generation, and system management, significantly boosting productivity.

repos.description: 班级小管家成绩处理工具
repos.summary_zh: XGJPlus 是一个班级小管家成绩处理工具，支持从多接口获取学生信息与成绩数据，并自动生成 Excel 报表。采用 Node.js 开发，提供命令行操作，适用于教育场景下的成绩批量管理与导出需求。
repos.summary_en: XGJPlus is a class management tool for processing student grades, supporting data retrieval from multiple interfaces and generating Excel reports. Built with Node.js, it offers command-line functionality ideal for educational institutions to automate grade management and export.

repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供多个电视盒子（TVBox）接口地址，包含免费公益接口与多版本资源链接，支持4K秒播专线，适用于影视播放应用。采用GitHub镜像加速访问，确保接口稳定可用，适合搭建个人影音平台。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers multiple TVBox interface addresses, including free public interfaces with stable 4K streaming support. It provides GitHub mirror links for reliable access and is ideal for building personal media platforms.

repos.summary_zh: AutoRedEnvelopeScript 是一个基于 Python、OpenCV 和 pyautogui 的自动化红包抢包工具，通过图像识别技术检测弹窗并模拟点击操作。用户需先用 screenshot.py 生成模板截图并填写坐标，再在 main.py 中配置实时定位，适用于安卓投屏或模拟器场景下的红包自动化处理。
repos.summary_en: AutoRedEnvelopeScript is a Python-based automation tool using OpenCV and pyautogui to detect red envelope popups via image recognition and simulate human-like clicks. Users generate template screenshots with screenshot.py, input coordinates into main.py for real-time detection, enabling automated red packet grabbing on Android devices or emulators.

repos.description: A script with html interface, generating Anki decks from the Language Reactor CSV export.
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本通过HTML界面将Language Reactor插件导出的CSV文件转换为Anki记忆卡片，利用AI大模型生成结构化数据（含词汇、例句、翻译等），支持多语言及日语假名标注，实现语言学习内容的自动化处理与知识图谱构建。
repos.summary_en: This script processes CSV exports from the Language Reactor Chrome extension via an HTML interface, using AI prompts to generate structured Anki flashcards with words, contexts, synonyms, translations, examples, and explanations—supporting multiple languages including Japanese with furigana support for automated language learning workflows.
